units.source: The Commitment Pooling Protocol (CPP) describes how independently governed Pools select Vouchers, publish exchange rules, and make exchanges possible. A Holder later uses a Voucher with its Issuer for the promised goods or services. These are separate steps, with separate responsibilities.
units.translation: Inilalarawan ng Commitment Pooling Protocol (CPP) kung paano pumipili ng mga Voucher ang mga Pool na may magkakahiwalay na pamamahala, naglalathala ng mga patakaran sa palitan, at nagbibigay-daan sa pagpapalitan. Ginagamit naman ng Mayhawak ang Voucher sa Tagapag-isyu para sa ipinangakong produkto o serbisyo. Magkahiwalay na hakbang ang mga ito, na may magkahiwalay na pananagutan.
units.backTranslation: The Commitment Pooling Protocol (CPP) describes how separately managed Pools select Vouchers, publish exchange policies, and enable exchange. The Holder uses the Voucher with the Issuer for the promised product or service. These are separate steps, with separate responsibilities.

units.source: This site explains those concepts and how to use the CLC App. The CLC software documentation is the definitive reference for software implementation, contracts, APIs, deployment, and operation. It is currently available in English.
units.translation: Ipinapaliwanag ng site na ito ang mga konseptong iyon at ang paggamit ng CLC App. Ang dokumentasyon ng CLC software ang pangunahing sanggunian para sa implementasyon ng software, mga contract, API, deployment, at pagpapatakbo. Nasa Ingles ito sa kasalukuyan.
units.backTranslation: This site explains those concepts and the use of CLC App. The CLC software documentation is the primary reference for software implementation, contracts, APIs, deployment, and operation. It is currently in English.

units.source: Start with Concepts and vocabulary for the shared terms, or the White Paper for the wider design and proposals.
units.translation: Magsimula sa Mga konsepto at bokabularyo para sa mga karaniwang termino, o sa White Paper para sa mas malawak na disenyo at mga panukala.
units.backTranslation: Start with the Concepts and Vocabulary for common terms, or the White Paper for broader designs and proposals.

units.source: Different communities and organizations can run compatible software under their own rules. Grassroots Economics Foundation operates the public CLC App. Each deployment should identify its operators, contracts, and responsible authorities.
units.translation: Maaaring magpatakbo ang iba't ibang komunidad at organisasyon ng magkatugmang software sa ilalim ng sarili nilang mga patakaran. Pinapatakbo ng Grassroots Economics Foundation ang pampublikong CLC App. Dapat tukuyin ng bawat deployment ang mga operator, contract, at awtoridad na may pananagutan dito.
units.backTranslation: Various communities and organizations may operate compatible software under their own policies. The Grassroots Economics Foundation operates the public CLC App. Each deployment should specify operators, contracts, and authorities responsible for it.

units.source: For contract addresses, deployment instructions, and how to verify owners and upgrade powers, use Deployments and verification. For running the supporting services, start with the CLC Core API.
units.translation: Para sa mga address ng contract, gabay sa deployment, at pagsusuri sa mga may-ari at kapangyarihang mag-upgrade, tingnan ang Deployment at beripikasyon. Para sa pagpapatakbo ng mga sumusuportang serbisyo, magsimula sa CLC Core API.
units.backTranslation: For contract addresses, deployment guidance, and review of owners and upgrade authorities, see Deployment and verification. For running supporting services, start with the CLC Core API.

units.source: The App can help a participant exchange through several Pools when a suitable route is available. The participant reviews the quote and authorizes the exchange. Each Pool keeps its own rules and responsible parties.
units.translation: Matutulungan ng App ang isang kalahok na magpalitan sa maraming Pool kapag may angkop na ruta. Sinusuri ng kalahok ang quote at pinapahintulutan ang palitan. Nananatili sa bawat Pool ang sarili nitong mga patakaran at responsableng partido.
units.backTranslation: The App will help a participant to exchange with multiple Pools when there is an appropriate route. The participant reviews the quote and authorizes the exchange. Each Pool maintains its own policies and responsible parties.

units.source: See Routes and responsibilities for what this means to participants, and Routing implementation for how the software quotes and executes routes.
units.translation: Tingnan ang Mga ruta at pananagutan para sa kahulugan nito sa mga kalahok, at ang Implementasyon ng routing para sa pag-quote at pagsasagawa ng mga ruta sa software.
units.backTranslation: See Routes and responsibilities for its meaning to participants, and the Implementing routing for quoting and executing routes in software.

units.source: Software enables the exchange; Issuers remain responsible for their Voucher promises, and Pool Stewards remain responsible for their published rules. Use of the public App is governed by the Terms of Service.
units.translation: Nagbibigay-daan ang software sa palitan; nananatiling responsable ang mga Tagapag-isyu sa mga pangako ng kanilang Voucher, at ang mga Tagapangasiwa ng Pool sa kanilang inilathalang patakaran. Ang paggamit sa pampublikong App ay saklaw ng Mga Tuntunin ng Serbisyo.
units.backTranslation: The software allows for exchange; Issuers remain responsible for the promises of their Vouchers, and Pool Administrators for their published policies. Use of the public App is subject to the Terms of Service.

units.source: Contracts record token balances and carry out Pool exchanges. The CLC software documentation is the definitive implementation reference, currently in English. This page explains what participants should understand before using those contracts.
units.translation: Itinatala ng mga contract ang balanse ng token at isinasagawa ang mga palitan sa Pool. Ang dokumentasyon ng CLC software ang pangunahing sanggunian sa implementasyon, na kasalukuyang nasa Ingles. Ipinapaliwanag ng pahinang ito ang dapat maunawaan ng mga kalahok bago gamitin ang mga contract.
units.backTranslation: The contracts record the token balance and perform exchanges in the Pool. The CLC software documentation is the primary reference for implementation, which is currently available in English. This page explains what participants need to understand before using the contracts.

units.source: See Concepts and vocabulary for the difference between a governed Commitment Pool and its SwapPool contract, and between exchange and Issuer fulfillment.
units.translation: Tingnan ang Mga konsepto at bokabularyo para sa pagkakaiba ng pinamamahalaang Pool ng Pangako at ng SwapPool contract nito, at ng palitan at pagtupad ng Tagapag-isyu.
units.backTranslation: See Concepts and Vocabulary for the difference between a Managed Pool of Promises and its SwapPool contract, and the exchange and execution of the Issuer.

units.source: A Voucher combines a digital balance with an Issuer's published promise. Its terms explain what it can be used for, where and when it is accepted, and who is responsible. Creating a token does not prove that the Issuer can provide the promised goods or services.
units.translation: Iniuugnay ng Voucher ang isang digital na balanse sa inilathalang pangako ng Tagapag-isyu. Ipinapaliwanag ng mga tuntunin kung para saan ito, saan at kailan ito tinatanggap, at sino ang may pananagutan. Ang paggawa ng token ay hindi patunay na kayang ibigay ng Tagapag-isyu ang ipinangakong produkto o serbisyo.
units.backTranslation: The Voucher links a digital balance to the Issuer’s issued promise. The terms explain for what it is used, where and when it is received, and who is responsible. The making of the token does not prove that the Issuers are able to deliver the promised product or service.

units.source: For creation, minting, burning, and expiry mechanics, read Vouchers.
units.translation: Para sa mekanismo ng paggawa, pag-mint, pag-burn, at pag-expire, basahin ang Mga Voucher.
units.backTranslation: For the mechanism of making, minting, burning, and expiring, see Vouchers.

units.source: A Commitment Pool brings selected Vouchers together under published rules. Its contract holds inventory and exchanges supported assets. A deposit does not automatically give the depositor Pool shares, repayment, withdrawal, reward, or governance rights; any such rights need separately disclosed terms.
units.translation: Pinagsasama ng Pool ng Pangako ang mga piling Voucher sa ilalim ng inilathalang mga patakaran. Hawak ng contract nito ang imbentaryo at ipinagpapalit nito ang mga suportadong asset. Hindi awtomatikong nagbibigay ang deposito ng bahagi sa Pool o karapatan sa pagbabayad, withdrawal, reward, o pamamahala; kailangan ng hiwalay na isiniwalat na mga tuntunin para sa mga karapatang iyon.
units.backTranslation: The Pool of Promises pools selected Vouchers under published policies. Its contract holds the inventory and exchanges the backed assets. Depositing a share into the Pool does not automatically confer rights to payment, withdrawal, reward, or management; separately disclosed terms are required for those rights.

units.source: Check which Vouchers a Pool accepts, how it sets exchange rates, its limits and fees, and who can change them. The software reference documents Pool configuration and sealing.
units.translation: Suriin kung aling Voucher ang tinatanggap ng Pool, paano nito itinatakda ang rate ng palitan, ang mga limitasyon at bayarin, at sino ang maaaring magbago ng mga ito. Inilalarawan ng sanggunian sa software ang configuration at pag-seal ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: Check which Vouchers the Pool accepts, how it sets the exchange rate, limits and fees, and who can change them. The software reference describes the configuration and sealing of the Pool.

units.source: A successful swap changes the relevant balances. It does not prove that an Issuer has delivered goods or services. Before confirming, review the input, output, recipient, minimum received, and quote expiry.
units.translation: Binabago ng matagumpay na palitan ang mga kaugnay na balanse. Hindi nito pinatutunayang naihatid na ng Tagapag-isyu ang produkto o serbisyo. Bago kumpirmahin, suriin ang input, output, tatanggap, minimum na matatanggap, at pag-expire ng quote.
units.backTranslation: A successful exchange changes the associated balances. It does not prove that the Issuer has delivered the product or service. Before confirming, check the input, output, recipient, minimum recipients, and quote expiration.

units.source: For execution methods and settlement records, read Quote and settle swaps.
units.translation: Para sa mga paraan ng pagsasagawa at tala ng settlement, basahin ang Pag-quote at pag-settle ng palitan.
units.backTranslation: For the methods of conduct and settlement records, see Quoting and Settlement of Exchanges.

units.source: A swap may include both a Pool fee and an additional protocol fee. Review the total shown in the quote; a route through several Pools can incur fees at each step. The swap reference maintains the calculation and worked example.
units.translation: Maaaring may bayarin sa Pool at karagdagang bayarin sa protocol ang isang palitan. Suriin ang kabuuang nasa quote; maaaring may bayarin sa bawat hakbang ng rutang dumaraan sa maraming Pool. Pinananatili sa sanggunian sa palitan ang kalkulasyon at halimbawang may mga halaga.
units.backTranslation: An exchange may have a Pool fee and additional protocol fees. Check the total on the quote; there may be charges for each step of the route that passes through multiple Pools. Calculations and examples with values are kept as reference to the exchange.

units.source: The Pool owner can withdraw available inventory. Other authorities may control upgrades or settings. Review these powers alongside the Steward's published rules before depositing or relying on a Pool. Sealed settings alone do not establish that inventory is permanently locked.
units.translation: Maaaring mag-withdraw ang may-ari ng Pool ng magagamit na imbentaryo. Maaaring ibang awtoridad ang may kontrol sa upgrade o mga setting. Suriin ang mga kapangyarihang ito kasama ng inilathalang mga patakaran ng Tagapangasiwa bago magdeposito o umasa sa Pool. Ang pag-seal sa mga setting lamang ay hindi patunay na permanenteng naka-lock ang imbentaryo.
units.backTranslation: The Pool owner may withdraw available inventory. Other authorities may have control over upgrades or settings. Check these powers along with the published Administrator policies before depositing or relying on the Pool. Sealing in settings alone does not prove that inventory is permanently locked.

units.source: See Pools and Verify an instance for the technical checks.
units.translation: Tingnan ang Mga Pool at Pagberipika ng isang instance para sa mga teknikal na pagsusuri.
units.backTranslation: See Pools and Verifying an Instance for technical analysis. See also:

units.source: A Pool's exchange rate is separate from a Voucher's stated value and the Issuer's redemption terms. Review the Pool's chosen method and who can change its inputs. The software reference explains the available Quoters.
units.translation: Magkahiwalay ang rate ng palitan ng Pool, ang nakasaad na halaga ng Voucher, at ang mga tuntunin ng Tagapag-isyu sa pagtubos. Suriin ang napiling paraan ng Pool at kung sino ang maaaring magbago ng mga input nito. Ipinapaliwanag ng sanggunian sa software ang mga available na Quoter.
units.backTranslation: The Pool exchange rate, the stated value of the Voucher, and the Issuer’s terms of redemption will be separate. Review the selected Pool method and who can change its inputs. The software reference explains the available Quoter.

units.source: The App's “Credit limit” is the maximum balance of a particular Voucher that a Pool may hold. It describes exchange capacity rather than personal borrowing or a guarantee of fulfillment. Review the Pool rules and configuration for how limits and fees are applied.
units.translation: Ang “Credit limit” sa App ang pinakamataas na balanse ng isang partikular na Voucher na maaaring hawakan ng Pool. Inilalarawan nito ang kapasidad sa palitan, hindi personal na pangungutang o garantiya ng pagtupad. Tingnan ang mga patakaran at configuration ng Pool para sa paglalapat ng limitasyon at bayarin.
units.backTranslation: The “Credit limit” in the App is the maximum balance of a particular Voucher that the Pool can handle. It describes the capacity for exchange, not personal borrowing or guaranteed performance. See the Pool’s policies and configuration for applying limits and charges.

units.source: A protocol fee has a configured recipient. Receiving that fee does not automatically make the recipient the Pool Steward or a guarantor. See the fee reference for current mechanics and governance mechanics for responsibility and disclosure.
units.translation: May naka-configure na tatanggap ang bayarin sa protocol. Hindi awtomatikong ginagawang Tagapangasiwa ng Pool o guarantor ang tatanggap dahil sa bayaring iyon. Tingnan ang sanggunian sa bayarin para sa kasalukuyang mekanismo at mga mekanismo ng pamamahala para sa pananagutan at pagsisiwalat.
units.backTranslation: The fee has a recipient configured in the protocol. That payment does not automatically make the recipients Pool Administrator or guarantor. See the fee reference for current mechanisms and governance mechanisms for accountability and disclosure.

units.source: Several independently governed Pools can connect the Voucher you hold to one you want. Each Pool supplies one step in the exchange, using its own rules and available inventory.
units.translation: Maaaring iugnay ng maraming Pool na magkakahiwalay ang pamamahala ang hawak mong Voucher sa Voucher na gusto mo. Bawat Pool ang nagbibigay ng isang hakbang sa palitan, gamit ang sarili nitong mga patakaran at magagamit na imbentaryo.
units.backTranslation: Several separately managed Pools can link your Voucher holding to the Voucher you want. Each Pool provides a step-by-step exchange, using its own policies and available inventory.

units.source: The CLC software routing reference is the definitive source for route discovery, eligibility, execution, and service interfaces. The software documentation is currently in English. This page explains the participant's journey and responsibilities.
units.translation: Ang sanggunian sa routing ng CLC software ang pangunahing sanggunian sa pagtuklas ng ruta, pagiging kwalipikado, pagsasagawa, at mga service interface. Nasa Ingles ang dokumentasyon ng software sa kasalukuyan. Ipinapaliwanag ng pahinang ito ang paglalakbay at pananagutan ng kalahok.
units.backTranslation: The CLC software routing reference is the primary reference for route discovery, qualification, execution, and service interfaces. The software documentation is currently in English. This page explains the journey and responsibilities of participants.

units.source: In the App's Credit view, choose the Voucher you want to Get or the one you want to Spend. A route might exchange a transport Voucher for a food Voucher through two different Pools.
units.translation: Sa view na Kredito ng App, piliin ang Voucher na gusto mong Kunin o ang nais mong Gastusin. Halimbawa, maaaring ipalit ng isang ruta ang Voucher sa transportasyon sa Voucher sa pagkain sa pamamagitan ng dalawang magkaibang Pool.
units.backTranslation: In the App Credits view, select the Voucher you want to Get or the one you want To Spend. For example, a route can replace a Transportation Voucher with a Food Voucher through two different Pools.

units.source: Finding a connection does not guarantee an exchange. The supported Vouchers, Pool limits, available inventory, fees, Wallet compatibility, and service availability must allow the requested amount.
units.translation: Hindi garantiya ng palitan ang pagkakaroon ng koneksyon. Dapat pahintulutan ng mga suportadong Voucher, limitasyon ng Pool, magagamit na imbentaryo, bayarin, pagiging katugma ng Wallet, at availability ng serbisyo ang hinihinging halaga.
units.backTranslation: The exchange does not guarantee connection. Supported Vouchers, Pool limitations, available inventory, charges, Wallet compatibility and service availability should allow the requested amount.

units.source: Review Route details before confirming: what you pay, what you receive, every participating Pool, the fees, the minimum received, and when the quote expires. An estimate helps you explore; the quote is the proposal you authorize. Refresh it if it expires or Pool conditions change.
units.translation: Suriin ang Mga detalye ng ruta bago kumpirmahin: ano ang ibabayad at matatanggap mo, bawat kasaling Pool, mga bayarin, minimum na matatanggap, at pag-expire ng quote. Nakatutulong ang tantiya sa pagtingin ng mga pagpipilian; ang quote ang panukalang pinapahintulutan mo. Kumuha ng bagong quote kung nag-expire ito o nagbago ang kalagayan ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: Check the Route Details before confirming: what you will pay and receive, each Pool involved, fees, minimums to receive, and quote expiration. The estimate helps in looking at options; the quote is the proposal you allow. Get a new quote if it expires or the Pool status changes.

units.source: The routing reference and service configuration maintain the technical eligibility rules and quote settings.
units.translation: Pinananatili sa sanggunian sa routing at configuration ng serbisyo ang mga teknikal na tuntunin sa pagiging kwalipikado at mga setting ng quote.
units.backTranslation: Technical terms of eligibility and quote settings are maintained in the service routing and configuration reference.

units.source: ### Signed atomic batch
units.translation: ### Pinirmahang atomic batch
units.backTranslation: ### The desired atomic batch.

units.source: You review and authorize the complete exchange. The current route succeeds as a whole or its Pool swaps revert together if a step fails. This protects against completing only part of the route; it does not guarantee that a later goods or services delivery will happen.
units.translation: Sinusuri at pinapahintulutan mo ang buong palitan. Sa kasalukuyang ruta, nagtatagumpay ang lahat ng palitan sa Pool o sabay-sabay na nababawi ang mga ito kapag may nabigong hakbang. Pinipigilan nito ang pagkumpleto ng bahagi lamang ng ruta; hindi nito ginagarantiya ang paghahatid ng produkto o serbisyo pagkatapos.
units.backTranslation: You review and authorize the entire exchange. In the current route, all exchanges in the Pool either succeed or are cancelled at once when a step fails. This prevents only part of the route from being completed; it does not guarantee delivery of the product or service afterwards.

units.source: For transaction construction and execution, see Execute a route.
units.translation: Para sa pagbuo at pagsasagawa ng transaksyon, tingnan ang Pagsasagawa ng ruta.
units.backTranslation: For creating and executing a transaction, see Executing a route.

units.source: The quote-only Solidity SwapRouter and the App's exchange workflow are different software components. Their relationship is explained in Routing.
units.translation: Magkaibang bahagi ng software ang quote-only na Solidity SwapRouter at ang daloy ng palitan sa App. Ipinapaliwanag ang ugnayan nila sa Routing.
units.backTranslation: The quote-only Solidity SwapRouter and the App exchange flow are separate parts of the software. Their relationship with Routing is explained.

units.source: For participants, the important check is the complete quote. Each Pool may charge fees. A shared route does not merge those Pools or make one Steward responsible for another Pool.
units.translation: Para sa kalahok, mahalagang suriin ang buong quote. Maaaring maningil ang bawat Pool. Hindi pinagsasama ng iisang ruta ang mga Pool o ginagawang responsable ang isang Tagapangasiwa sa ibang Pool.
units.backTranslation: For the participant, it is important to check the full quote. Each Pool may charge. One route does not combine Pools or make one Administrator responsible for another Pool.

units.source: ### Receipt and failure states
units.translation: ### Resibo at mga katayuan ng pagkabigo
units.backTranslation: ### Receipt and failure statuses.

units.source: After submission, check whether the exchange is pending, confirmed, or failed, and keep the receipt. If no route is available, try refreshing, reducing the amount, or choosing another supported input Voucher.
units.translation: Pagkatapos magsumite, tingnan kung nakabinbin, kumpirmado, o nabigo ang palitan, at itago ang resibo. Kung walang ruta, subukang mag-refresh, bawasan ang halaga, o pumili ng ibang suportadong input Voucher.
units.backTranslation: After submitting, check if the exchange has been placed, confirmed, or failed and hide the receipt. If no route is available, try refreshing, reducing the amount, or choosing another supported Voucher input.

units.source: A failed exchange does not change the Issuer's existing promises. A successful exchange records changed balances; fulfillment and discharge still follow the Issuer's terms. See the practical examples.
units.translation: Hindi binabago ng nabigong palitan ang mga naunang pangako ng Tagapag-isyu. Itinatala ng matagumpay na palitan ang pagbabago ng balanse; sumusunod pa rin sa mga tuntunin ng Tagapag-isyu ang pagtupad at discharge. Tingnan ang mga praktikal na halimbawa.
units.backTranslation: Failed exchange does not change the Issuer's previous commitments. A successful exchange records the balance change; performance and discharge still follow the terms of the Issuers. See practical examples.

units.source: Developers can find transaction and tracking interfaces in the CLC Core API reference.
units.translation: Makikita ng mga developer ang mga interface para sa transaksyon at pagsubaybay sa sanggunian sa CLC Core API.
units.backTranslation: Developers can see interfaces for transaction and tracking by reference to the CLC Core API.

units.source: ## Pool internals
units.translation: ## Mga panloob na bahagi ng Pool
units.backTranslation: ## Interior parts of the Pool

units.source: Before relying on a Pool, identify its Steward, contract owner, upgrade authorities, fee recipients, and anyone who can change material settings. A technical controller and an accountable Steward may be different parties.
units.translation: Bago umasa sa Pool, tukuyin ang Tagapangasiwa, may-ari ng contract, mga awtoridad sa upgrade, tatanggap ng bayarin, at sinumang maaaring magbago ng mahahalagang setting. Maaaring magkaibang partido ang teknikal na controller at ang Tagapangasiwang may pananagutan.
units.backTranslation: Before relying on the Pool, identify the Administrator, contract owner, upgrade authorities, payable persons and anyone who can change important settings. The technical controller and the responsible Committer may be different parties.

units.source: The software reference maintains Pool mechanics and deployment verification. These docs explain roles and vocabulary, governance responsibilities, and the wider CPP design.
units.translation: Pinananatili ng sanggunian sa software ang mga mekanismo ng Pool at beripikasyon ng deployment. Ipinapaliwanag dito ang mga tungkulin at bokabularyo, mga pananagutan sa pamamahala, at ang mas malawak na disenyo ng CPP.
units.backTranslation: The software reference maintains the Pool mechanisms and deployment verification. It explains roles and vocabulary, management responsibilities, and the broader design of CPP.

units.source: Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC) helps people describe what they offer, publish what they need, and exchange vouchers through independently governed Commitment Pools. Open the CLC App to begin.
units.translation: Tinutulungan ng Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC) ang mga tao na ilarawan ang iniaalok nila, ilathala ang kailangan nila, at magpalitan ng mga Voucher sa pamamagitan ng mga Pool ng Pangako na magkakahiwalay ang pamamahala. Buksan ang CLC App upang magsimula.
units.backTranslation: Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC) helps people describe what they offer, publish what they need, and exchange Vouchers through separately managed Pools of Promises. Open the CLC App to get started.

units.source: The basic idea is simple:
units.translation: Simple ang pangunahing ideya:
units.backTranslation: The basic idea is simple: a simple, easy-to-follow guideline.

units.source: 1. Create a voucher—much like a gift card—for something you can provide.
units.translation: 1. Gumawa ng Voucher—na parang gift card—para sa kaya mong ibigay.
units.backTranslation: 1. Make Vouchers—like gift cards—for what you can afford to give.

units.source: 2. Publish an Offering so people can discover the related goods or services.
units.translation: 2. Maglathala ng Offering upang makita ng iba ang kaugnay na produkto o serbisyo.
units.backTranslation: 2. Post an Offering to let others see the related product or service.

units.source: 3. Publish or respond to a Want to find possible exchange partners.
units.translation: 3. Maglathala o tumugon sa Pangangailangan upang makahanap ng posibleng kapartner sa palitan.
units.backTranslation: 3. Post or respond to Needs to find potential exchange partners.

units.source: 4. Use a Commitment Pool to exchange supported vouchers under published rules.
units.translation: 4. Gumamit ng Pool ng Pangako upang magpalitan ng mga suportadong Voucher sa ilalim ng inilathalang mga patakaran.
units.backTranslation: 4. Use the Pool of Promises to exchange supported Vouchers under published policies.

units.source: 5. Use a voucher with its Issuer for what its terms promise.
units.translation: 5. Gamitin ang Voucher sa Tagapag-isyu para sa ipinangako sa mga tuntunin nito.
units.backTranslation: 5. Use the Voucher with the Issuer for the purposes promised in its terms.

units.source: “Credit” in the App means recognized commitments and Voucher exchange capacity. It is not automatically a personal loan, borrowing limit, or promise to advance money.
units.translation: Ang “Kredito” sa App ay tumutukoy sa mga kinikilalang pangako at kapasidad sa pagpapalitan ng Voucher. Hindi ito awtomatikong personal na pautang, limitasyon sa pangungutang, o pangakong magbigay ng paunang pera.
units.backTranslation: “Credit” in the App refers to recognized pledges and capacity for redemption of Vouchers. This does not automatically constitute a personal loan, limit on borrowing, or promise to provide initial money.

units.source: For exact definitions, see Concepts and vocabulary.
units.translation: Para sa eksaktong kahulugan, tingnan ang Mga konsepto at bokabularyo.
units.backTranslation: For the exact definition, see Concepts and vocabulary.

units.source: ## A first journey through the App
units.translation: ## Unang paglalakbay sa App
units.backTranslation: ## First trip to the App

units.source: ### 1. Explore the Market and Wants
units.translation: ### 1. Tingnan ang Pamilihan at mga Pangangailangan
units.backTranslation: ### 1. Look at the Market and Needs.

units.source: Browse the CLC App before creating anything. The Market is a discovery catalog, not automatically a seller, exchange venue, endorsement, or guarantee.
units.translation: Tingnan muna ang CLC App bago gumawa ng anuman. Ang Pamilihan ay katalogo para sa pagtuklas, hindi awtomatikong nagbebenta, lugar ng palitan, pag-endorso, o garantiya.
units.backTranslation: The Marketplace is a catalog for discovery, not an automatic seller, place of exchange, endorsement, or warranty. Please check the CLC App before doing anything.

units.source: When reviewing a Voucher, check:
units.translation: Kapag sinusuri ang Voucher, tingnan:
units.backTranslation: When checking the Voucher, see: Checking the Vehicle

units.source: - who issued it;
units.translation: - sino ang nag-isyu nito;
units.backTranslation: - who issued it; who is the holder of the card;

units.source: - the goods or services it promises;
units.translation: - anong produkto o serbisyo ang ipinapangako nito;
units.backTranslation: - what product or service it promises; what kind of product or services it sells.

units.source: - where, when, and how it can be used;
units.translation: - saan, kailan, at paano ito magagamit;
units.backTranslation: - where, when, and how it is available; where, how, and when it is not available.

units.source: - its limits, expiry, contact method, and complaint process; and
units.translation: - ang mga limitasyon, pag-expire, paraan ng pakikipag-ugnayan, at proseso ng reklamo; at
units.backTranslation: - the limitations, expirations, means of contact, and complaint process; and

units.source: - which Commitment Pools support it.
units.translation: - aling mga Pool ng Pangako ang sumusuporta rito.
units.backTranslation: - which Promise Pools support it.

units.source: A Want expresses demand. Publishing or answering one does not automatically accept a Voucher, reserve goods, authorize an exchange, or create an obligation. Contacting or messaging another participant also does not by itself create, fulfill, or discharge a Voucher commitment.
units.translation: Ang Pangangailangan (Want) ay nagpapahayag ng hinahanap ng kalahok. Ang paglalathala o pagtugon dito ay hindi awtomatikong pagtanggap ng Voucher, pagreserba ng produkto, pagpapahintulot sa palitan, o paglikha ng obligasyon. Ang pakikipag-ugnayan o pagmemensahe sa iba ay hindi rin, sa sarili nito, lumilikha, tumutupad, o nagdi-discharge ng pangako sa Voucher.
units.backTranslation: The Want expresses the participant’s desire. Posting or responding to it does not automatically accept the Voucher, reserve a product, authorize an exchange, or create any obligation. Interaction or messaging with others also does not, in itself, create, fulfill, or discharge the commitment of the Vehicle.

units.source: The App uses an account for profile and session access and a Wallet for blockchain authorization. Protect your passkey, paper-wallet material, recovery information, devices, and any other credentials. Review every address, asset, amount, Pool, fee, and authorization before confirming a transaction.
units.translation: Gumagamit ang App ng account para sa profile at session access, at ng Wallet para sa awtorisasyon sa blockchain. Protektahan ang iyong passkey, mga materyal ng paper wallet, impormasyon sa pagbawi ng access, mga device, at iba pang credential. Suriin ang bawat address, asset, halaga, Pool, bayarin, at awtorisasyon bago kumpirmahin ang transaksyon.
units.backTranslation: The App uses the Account for profile and session access, and the Wallet for blockchain authorization. Protect your passkey, paper wallet materials, access recovery information, devices, and other credentials. Review each address, asset, amount, Pool, charge, and authorization before confirming the transaction.

units.source: The interface asks you to confirm the Terms during onboarding and before publishing a Voucher or Pool. Read the Terms of Service and Privacy Notice before continuing.
units.translation: Hinihingi ng interface ang pagkumpirma mo sa mga Tuntunin habang nagsisimula at bago maglathala ng Voucher o Pool. Basahin ang Mga Tuntunin ng Serbisyo at Abiso sa Privacy bago magpatuloy.
units.backTranslation: The interface will ask you to confirm the Terms at start and before publishing a Voucher or Pool. Please read the Term of Service and Privacy Notice before proceeding.

units.source: ### 3. Create a Voucher and Offering
units.translation: ### 3. Gumawa ng Voucher at Offering
units.backTranslation: ### 3. Make Voucher and Offering.

units.source: Create a Voucher for something you can reasonably provide. Think of it as making your own gift card: you describe what it represents and the conditions for using it.
units.translation: Gumawa ng Voucher para sa makatuwirang kaya mong ibigay. Isipin itong paggawa ng sarili mong gift card: inilalarawan mo ang kinakatawan nito at ang mga kondisyon sa paggamit.
units.backTranslation: Make Vouchers for what you can reasonably afford to give. Imagine it as making your own gift card: you describe what it represents and the conditions of use.

units.source: A complete Voucher has several separate layers:
units.translation: May ilang magkakahiwalay na bahagi ang kumpletong Voucher:
units.backTranslation: The complete Voucher has several separate parts: a voucher card, a coupon and a gift card.

units.source: 1. token-contract mechanics and balances;
units.translation: 1. mekanismo at mga balanse ng token contract;
units.backTranslation: 1. mechanism and balances of token contract; mechanisms of the token contract

units.source: 2. the Issuer's published Voucher terms;
units.translation: 2. inilathalang mga tuntunin ng Tagapag-isyu para sa Voucher;
units.backTranslation: 2. the published terms of the Issuer for the Voucher;

units.source: 3. one or more Offering records describing associated goods or services; and
units.translation: 3. isa o higit pang tala ng Offering na naglalarawan sa kaugnay na produkto o serbisyo; at
units.backTranslation: 3. one or more records of the Offering describing the related product or service; and

units.source: 4. the Issuer's real-world fulfillment.
units.translation: 4. aktuwal na pagtupad ng Tagapag-isyu.
units.backTranslation: 4. actual performance of the Issuer.

units.source: Creating or minting a token does not prove that an Offering exists, that the Issuer has capacity, or that Grassroots Economics Foundation (GEF) guarantees fulfillment.
units.translation: Ang paggawa o pag-mint ng token ay hindi patunay na may Offering, may kakayahang tumupad ang Tagapag-isyu, o ginagarantiyahan ng Grassroots Economics Foundation (GEF) ang pagtupad.
units.backTranslation: The making or minting of a token does not prove that there is an Offering, the Issuer is able to perform, or the Grassroots Economics Foundation (GEF) guarantees performance.

units.source: ### 4. Publish or respond to a Want
units.translation: ### 4. Maglathala o tumugon sa Pangangailangan
units.backTranslation: ### 4. Post or respond to Needs.

units.source: Use a Want to describe something you are looking for, including the amount, place, timing, and a suitable contact method. Another participant can discover it, review your public Vouchers and Offerings, and decide whether to contact you.
units.translation: Gumamit ng Pangangailangan upang ilarawan ang hinahanap mo, kasama ang dami, lugar, oras, at angkop na paraan ng pakikipag-ugnayan. Maaaring makita ito ng ibang kalahok, suriin ang iyong pampublikong Voucher at Offering, at magpasya kung makikipag-ugnayan sa iyo.
units.backTranslation: Use the Need to describe what you are looking for, including quantity, location, time, and appropriate means of contact. Other participants can see this, review your public Voucher and Offering, and decide whether to contact you.

units.source: Keep negotiation and responsibility clear. A message can help participants agree on delivery, booking, or other details, but the applicable Voucher terms and any separately agreed transaction terms determine the commitment.
units.translation: Panatilihing malinaw ang napag-uusapan at ang pananagutan. Makatutulong ang mensahe upang magkasundo sa paghahatid, booking, o ibang detalye, ngunit ang naaangkop na tuntunin ng Voucher at anumang hiwalay na napagkasunduang tuntunin ng transaksyon ang nagtatakda ng pangako.
units.backTranslation: The message may help to agree on delivery, booking, or other details, but the applicable terms of the Voucher and any separately agreed transaction terms set the promise. Keep clear what is being talked about and who is responsible.

units.source: ### 5. Find or create a Commitment Pool
units.translation: ### 5. Maghanap o gumawa ng Pool ng Pangako
units.backTranslation: ### 5. Find or create a Pool of Promises.

units.source: A Commitment Pool curates selected Vouchers and enables their exchange. Before using or supporting one, review:
units.translation: Pumipili ang Pool ng Pangako ng mga Voucher at nagbibigay-daan sa pagpapalitan ng mga ito. Bago gumamit o sumuporta sa Pool, suriin:
units.backTranslation: The Pool of Promises selects Vouchers and allows them to be exchanged. Before using or supporting the Pool, please check:

units.source: - the accountable Pool Steward and current contract owner;
units.translation: - ang Tagapangasiwa ng Pool na may pananagutan at ang kasalukuyang may-ari ng contract;
units.backTranslation: - the Pool Manager responsible and the current owner of the contract;

units.source: - admitted Vouchers and other supported assets;
units.translation: - ang mga tinanggap na Voucher at iba pang suportadong asset;
units.backTranslation: - the Vouchers and other supported assets received; - the amount of Voucher and other backed assets accepted;

units.source: - exchange-rate or quote methods;
units.translation: - ang mga paraan ng rate ng palitan o quote;
units.backTranslation: - the means of exchange rate or quote; the exchange rate is a measure of the value of a commodity.

units.source: - the App's “Credit limit”, which is a Pool token-balance cap rather than personal credit;
units.translation: - ang “Credit limit” sa App, na pinakamataas na balanse ng token sa Pool at hindi personal na kredito;
units.backTranslation: - the “Credit limit” in the App, which is the maximum token balance in the Pool and not personal credit;

units.source: - Pool and protocol fees;
units.translation: - ang mga bayarin sa Pool at protocol;
units.backTranslation: - the fees to the Pool and protocol; the fees of the pool.

units.source: - available inventory and the Pool owner's liquidity-withdrawal power;
units.translation: - ang magagamit na imbentaryo at kapangyarihan ng may-ari ng Pool na mag-withdraw ng liquidity;
units.backTranslation: - the available inventory and Pool owner's power to withdraw liquidity; - the pool owner' s power to deal with the pool.

units.source: - proxy, multisig, and dependency controllers; and
units.translation: - ang proxy, multisig, at mga dependency controller; at
units.backTranslation: - the proxy, multisig, and dependency controllers; and the proxies.

units.source: - any separately published contribution, guarantee, reserve, reward, or insurance terms.
units.translation: - ang anumang hiwalay na inilathalang tuntunin sa kontribusyon, garantiya, reserba, reward, o insurance.
units.backTranslation: - any separately published terms of contribution, guarantee, reserve, reward, or insurance.

units.source: Depositing transfers assets into the Pool's SwapPool. Protocol v1.1.0 does not automatically give a depositor Pool shares, repayment, withdrawal, reward, or governance rights.
units.translation: Inililipat ng deposito ang mga asset sa SwapPool ng Pool. Hindi awtomatikong nagbibigay ang Protocol v1.1.0 ng bahagi sa Pool o karapatan sa pagbabayad, withdrawal, reward, o pamamahala sa nagdeposito.
units.backTranslation: The deposit transfers assets to the Pool’s SwapPool. Protocol v1.1.0 does not automatically grant a share in the Pool or any rights of payment, withdrawal, reward, or management to the depositor.

units.source: ### 6. Send or exchange Vouchers
units.translation: ### 6. Magpadala o magpalitan ng mga Voucher
units.backTranslation: ### 6. Send or exchange Vouchers.

units.source: Use Send to transfer a Voucher directly. Use a Pool swap to exchange one supported asset for another through one Pool.
units.translation: Gamitin ang Ipadala upang direktang ilipat ang Voucher. Gamitin ang palitan sa Pool upang ipalit ang isang suportadong asset sa isa pa sa pamamagitan ng isang Pool.
units.backTranslation: Use the Send button to directly transfer the Voucher. Use Pool Exchange to exchange one supported asset for another through a Pool.

units.source: The App's Credit view can also find Vouchers reachable through several independently governed Pools. Choose Get for the Voucher you want or Spend for the Voucher you want to use. Then review:
units.translation: Makakahanap din ang view na Kredito ng App ng mga Voucher na maaabot sa maraming Pool na magkakahiwalay ang pamamahala. Piliin ang Kunin para sa Voucher na gusto mo o Gastusin para sa Voucher na nais mong gamitin. Pagkatapos, suriin:
units.backTranslation: The App Credit view will also find Vouchers that are available in multiple separately managed Pools. Select Get for the Voucher you want or Spend for the voucher you wish to use. Then, check:

units.source: 1. the Pay with choice and Estimate;
units.translation: 1. ang napiling Magbayad gamit ang at ang Tantiya;
units.backTranslation: 1. the selected Pay with and the Estimate; 2. the Seller's Account;

units.source: 2. Route details, including every Pool, amount, Pool fee, and protocol fee;
units.translation: 2. ang Mga detalye ng ruta, kasama ang bawat Pool, halaga, bayarin sa Pool, at bayarin sa protocol;
units.backTranslation: 2. the Route details, including each Pool, amount, Pool fee, and protocol fee;

units.source: 3. the minimum amount received and quote expiry; and
units.translation: 3. ang minimum na matatanggap at pag-expire ng quote; at
units.backTranslation: 3. the minimum receipt and expiration of the quote; and

units.source: 4. the prepared Wallet batch before choosing Confirm exchange.
units.translation: 4. ang inihandang Wallet batch bago piliin ang Kumpirmahin ang palitan.
units.backTranslation: 4. the prepared Wallet batch before selecting Confirm exchange.

units.source: Not every Voucher, Pool, or Wallet supports routed exchange. The App checks whether an exchange is available for your choices. The software routing reference maintains the current eligibility rules and technical requirements in English.
units.translation: Hindi lahat ng Voucher, Pool, o Wallet ay sumusuporta sa palitan sa isang ruta. Sinusuri ng App kung may palitang available para sa iyong mga pinili. Pinananatili sa sanggunian sa routing ng software ang kasalukuyang mga tuntunin sa pagiging kwalipikado at teknikal na kinakailangan, sa Ingles.
units.backTranslation: Not all Vouchers, Pools, or Wallets support exchanges on a route. The App checks if there are exchanges available for your chosen ones. The current terms of eligibility and technical requirements are maintained in the software routing reference.

units.source: Route discovery is an estimate. Review the final quote before signing, including the minimum received and expiry. The current routed exchange succeeds as a whole or its Pool swaps revert together. After submission, check the receipt for the outcome, exchanged amounts, and fees.
units.translation: Tantiya ang pagtuklas ng ruta. Suriin ang huling quote bago pumirma, kasama ang minimum na matatanggap at pag-expire. Sa kasalukuyan, nagtatagumpay ang buong routed exchange o sabay-sabay na nababawi ang mga palitan nito sa Pool. Pagkatapos magsumite, tingnan ang resibo para sa resulta, ipinagpalit na mga halaga, at bayarin.
units.backTranslation: Check the final quote before signing, including minimum receipt and expiration. Currently, the entire routed exchange succeeds or simultaneously drops its exchanges into the Pool. After submitting, refer to the receipt for the result, amounts traded, and fees.

units.source: ### 7. Use a Voucher with its Issuer
units.translation: ### 7. Gamitin ang Voucher sa Tagapag-isyu
units.backTranslation: ### 7. Use the Voucher at the Issuer.

units.source: Read the Voucher terms and follow the Issuer's booking, delivery, or contact process. In the current App, “Redeem” opens the ordinary send flow with the token owner's address prefilled. Sending the Voucher is redemption presentment; it does not prove that the Issuer has provided the promised goods or services.
units.translation: Basahin ang mga tuntunin ng Voucher at sundin ang proseso ng Tagapag-isyu para sa booking, paghahatid, o pakikipag-ugnayan. Sa kasalukuyang App, binubuksan ng “Tubusin” ang karaniwang pagpapadala na nakalagay na ang address ng may-ari ng token. Ang pagpapadala ng Voucher ay paghaharap para sa pagtubos; hindi nito pinatutunayang naibigay na ng Tagapag-isyu ang ipinangakong produkto o serbisyo.
units.backTranslation: Read the Voucher terms and follow the Issuer’s process for booking, delivery, or communication. In the current App, “Redeem” opens a standard shipping address that is already listed as the address of the token owner. Sending the Vehicle is a presentation for redemption; it does not prove that the Issuers have delivered the promised product or service.

units.source: After fulfillment, the Issuer should record discharge so fulfilled units cannot be used again—for example by receiving, burning, cancelling, or otherwise disabling them under the published terms.
units.translation: Pagkatapos tumupad, dapat itala ng Tagapag-isyu ang discharge upang hindi magamit muli ang mga natupad nang yunit—halimbawa, sa pamamagitan ng pagtanggap, pag-burn, pagkansela, o ibang paraan ng pagpapahinto sa paggamit alinsunod sa inilathalang mga tuntunin.
units.backTranslation: After compliance, the Issuer must record discharge so that the fulfilled units are not reused—for example, by acceptance, burning, cancellation, or other means of discontinuing use in accordance with the posted terms.

units.source: ## Before you publish
units.translation: ## Bago ka maglathala
units.backTranslation: ## Before you publish, check your content.

units.source: Voucher, Pool, Offering, Want, Catalog, Post, and Review information can have different visibility. Before publishing a resource:
units.translation: Maaaring magkakaiba ang visibility ng impormasyon ng Voucher, Pool, Offering, Pangangailangan, Katalogo, Post, at Review. Bago maglathala ng resource:
units.backTranslation: The visibility of Voucher, Pool, Offering, Needs, Catalog, Post, and Review information may vary. Before publishing a resource:

units.source: - choose a map point that is safe to make public; exact coordinates may be visible;
units.translation: - pumili ng puntong ligtas ipakita sa pampublikong mapa; maaaring makita ang eksaktong coordinate;
units.backTranslation: - select a point to safely show on the public map; can see the exact coordinate; can view the location of the point

units.source: - check which information is visible while signed out and while signed in;
units.translation: - tingnan kung anong impormasyon ang nakikita habang naka-sign out at naka-sign in;
units.backTranslation: - see what information is visible while signed out and signed in; see what you can do when you are logged in.

units.source: - use contact details that are suitable for the intended audience;
units.translation: - gumamit ng contact detail na angkop sa nilalayong makakakita nito;
units.backTranslation: - use contact details that are appropriate to the purpose for which they will be used;

units.source: - do not copy private profile information into a public resource unless you intend to publish it; and
units.translation: - huwag kopyahin ang pribadong impormasyon ng profile sa pampublikong resource maliban kung nais mo itong ilathala; at
units.backTranslation: - do not copy private profile information to public resource unless you want to publish it; and

units.source: - read the Privacy Notice's “What becomes public?” section.
units.translation: - basahin ang seksyong “Ano ang nagiging pampubliko?” sa Abiso sa Privacy.
units.backTranslation: - read the section “What is becoming public?” in the Privacy Notice.

units.source: ## Current App actions
units.translation: ## Kasalukuyang mga kilos sa App
units.backTranslation: ## Current actions in the App.

units.source: App action  What it does
units.translation: Kilos sa App  Ginagawa nito
units.backTranslation: Actions in App  Does this:

units.source: Send  Transfers a token balance to another address.
units.translation: Ipadala  Inililipat ang balanse ng token sa ibang address.
units.backTranslation: Send  Transfers the token balance to another address.

units.source: Pool swap  Exchanges supported assets through one SwapPool. On-chain settlement does not prove Issuer fulfillment.
units.translation: Palitan sa Pool  Ipinagpapalit ang suportadong mga asset sa isang SwapPool. Hindi patunay ng pagtupad ng Tagapag-isyu ang on-chain settlement.
units.backTranslation: Pool Settlement  Exchanges the supported assets in a SwapPool. The on-chain settlement does not prove Issuer’s compliance.

units.source: Routed exchange  Executes an ordered set of Pool swaps in one bounded, same-chain Wallet transaction. It does not merge the Pools' governance.
units.translation: Routed exchange  Isinasagawa ang sunod-sunod na palitan sa Pool sa isang bounded na transaksyon ng Wallet sa iisang chain. Hindi nito pinagsasama ang pamamahala ng mga Pool.
units.backTranslation: Routed exchange  Performs sequential Pool exchanges in a bounded Wallet transaction on the same chain. It does not consolidate Pool management.

units.source: “Redeem”  Prefills a send to the token owner as redemption presentment. Fulfillment and discharge remain separate.
units.translation: “Tubusin”  Inihahanda ang pagpapadala sa may-ari ng token bilang paghaharap para sa pagtubos. Magkahiwalay pa rin ang pagtupad at discharge.
units.backTranslation: “Redeem”  Prepares the shipment to the token owner as a presentation for redemption. Fulfillment and discharge will remain separate.

units.source: “Request retirement”  Lets the current owner ask an administrator to retire a Voucher or Pool. The resource remains active while the request is pending; the owner can cancel the request, and an administrator can approve or reject it. Retirement does not delete contracts, balances, or history.
units.translation: “Humiling ng pag-retire”  Hinahayaan ang kasalukuyang may-ari na hilingin sa administrator ang pag-retire ng Voucher o Pool. Aktibo pa rin ang resource habang nakabinbin ang hiling; maaaring kanselahin ito ng may-ari at aprubahan o tanggihan ng administrator. Hindi binubura ng pag-retire ang mga contract, balanse, o kasaysayan.
units.backTranslation: “Request withdrawal”  Allows the current owner to request the administrator to withdraw a Voucher or Pool. The resource remains active while the request is pending; it can be cancelled by the owner and approved or rejected by the administrator. Retirement does not delete contracts, balances, or history.

units.source: Pool retirement  After approval, blocks new Pool swaps and deposits while keeping available withdrawals possible. It does not erase prior settlement records.
units.translation: Pag-retire ng Pool  Kapag naaprubahan, hinaharangan ang mga bagong palitan at deposito sa Pool habang pinapayagan pa rin ang available na withdrawal. Hindi nito binubura ang mga naunang tala ng settlement.
units.backTranslation: Pool Withdrawal  Once approved, new exchanges and deposits to the Pool are blocked while still allowing available withdrawals. This does not erase previous settlement records.

units.source: Pool liquidity withdrawal  Lets the Pool owner transfer available inventory to a selected address.
units.translation: Pag-withdraw ng liquidity sa Pool  Hinahayaan ang may-ari ng Pool na ilipat ang magagamit na imbentaryo sa piniling address.
units.backTranslation: Withdrawing liquidity from the Pool  Allows the Pool owner to move available inventory to the selected address.

units.source: Fee collection  Sends accrued Pool fees to the configured recipient.
units.translation: Pagkolekta ng bayarin  Ipinapadala ang naipong bayarin sa Pool sa naka-configure na tatanggap.
units.backTranslation: Fees Collection  Sends the fee collected in the Pool to the configured recipient.

units.source: ## Responsibilities and important limits
units.translation: ## Mga pananagutan at mahahalagang limitasyon
units.backTranslation: ## Liabilities and material limitations

units.source: Grassroots Economics Foundation operates the App and supporting infrastructure. Unless GEF expressly accepts another role for a particular transaction, it is not the Issuer of a user-created Voucher, the Steward of a user-created Pool, a custodian, lender, borrower, guarantor, insurer, or redeemer.
units.translation: Pinapatakbo ng Grassroots Economics Foundation ang App at sumusuportang imprastraktura. Maliban kung hayagang tanggapin ng GEF ang ibang tungkulin para sa partikular na transaksyon, hindi ito ang Tagapag-isyu ng Voucher na ginawa ng user, Tagapangasiwa ng Pool na ginawa ng user, custodian, nagpapautang, nangungutang, guarantor, insurer, o tumutubos.
units.backTranslation: The App and supporting infrastructure are operated by the Grassroots Economics Foundation. Unless GEF expressly accepts other duty for a particular transaction, it is not the User-Made Voucher Issuer, User-made Pool Administrator, custodian, lender, borrower, guarantor, insurer, or payer.

units.source: Before transacting, remember:
units.translation: Bago makipagtransaksyon, tandaan:
units.backTranslation: Before you transact, note:

units.source: - You must meet the Terms' age, legal-capacity, and jurisdiction requirements.
units.translation: - Dapat mong matugunan ang mga kinakailangan ng Tuntunin sa edad, legal na kakayahan, at hurisdiksiyon.
units.backTranslation: - You must meet the requirements of the Terms regarding age, legal capacity, and jurisdiction.

units.source: - Issuers are responsible for their Voucher commitments.
units.translation: - Responsable ang mga Tagapag-isyu sa mga pangako ng kanilang Voucher.
units.backTranslation: - Issuers are responsible for the promises of their Voucher. Issuers shall not be liable to any third party for any loss or damage arising from the use of their vouchers.

units.source: - Pool Stewards are responsible for their published Pool rules and any guarantee they expressly assume.
units.translation: - Responsable ang mga Tagapangasiwa ng Pool sa inilathalang mga patakaran at anumang garantiyang hayagan nilang inaako.
units.backTranslation: - Pool Managers are responsible for the published policies and any warranties they voluntarily assume.

units.source: - A listing, review, route, limit, reserve, or blockchain record is not automatically an endorsement, valuation, fulfillment record, guarantee, insurance policy, or promise of cash-out.
units.translation: - Ang listing, review, ruta, limitasyon, reserba, o tala sa blockchain ay hindi awtomatikong pag-endorso, valuation, tala ng pagtupad, garantiya, insurance policy, o pangako ng cash-out.
units.backTranslation: - A listing, review, route, limitation, reservation, or record on the blockchain does not automatically constitute an endorsement, valuation, performance record, guarantee, insurance policy, or cash-out promise.

units.source: - Payment services, rewards, contribution arrangements, and other provider integrations are deployment-dependent and require their own disclosures.
units.translation: - Nakadepende sa deployment ang mga serbisyo sa pagbabayad, reward, kaayusan sa kontribusyon, at ibang integration ng provider, at kailangan nila ng sariling pagsisiwalat.
units.backTranslation: - Payment services, rewards, contribution arrangements and other provider integrations are deployment-dependent, and require their own disclosure.

units.source: The App supports direct and routed Pool exchanges where available. Cross-chain routing, automatic Pool rebalancing, batch netting, shared insurance, proposed governance assets, network liquidity programs, and regulated payment rails remain proposed or deployment-dependent unless a specific deployment identifies them as active.
units.translation: Sinusuportahan ng App ang direkta at routed na mga palitan sa Pool kung available. Nananatiling iminungkahi o nakadepende sa deployment ang cross-chain routing, awtomatikong pagbabalanse ng Pool, batch netting, shared insurance, iminungkahing governance asset, network liquidity program, at regulated payment rail, maliban kung tinutukoy ng partikular na deployment na aktibo ang mga ito.
units.backTranslation: The App supports direct and routed Pool exchanges where available. Cross-chain routing, automatic Pool balancing, batch netting, shared insurance, proposed governance asset, network liquidity program, and regulated payment rail remain suggested or deployment dependent unless the particular deployments specify that they are active.

units.source: See the simple and advanced examples, the Protocol overview, or governance mechanics for more detail.
units.translation: Tingnan ang simple at mas advanced na halimbawa, pangkalahatang-ideya ng Protokol, o mga mekanismo ng pamamahala para sa higit pang detalye.
units.backTranslation: See the simple and more advanced examples, Protocol overview, or Management mechanisms for more detail.

units.source: Cosmo-Local Credit connects people who offer goods or services, people who need them, and independently governed Commitment Pools that enable Voucher exchange. This page begins with the terms a participant sees, then explains the technical layers beneath them.
units.translation: Iniuugnay ng Cosmo-Local Credit ang mga nag-aalok ng produkto o serbisyo, ang mga nangangailangan nito, at ang mga Pool ng Pangako na magkakahiwalay ang pamamahala at nagbibigay-daan sa pagpapalitan ng Voucher. Nagsisimula ang pahinang ito sa mga terminong makikita ng kalahok, bago ipaliwanag ang mga teknikal na bahagi sa likod ng mga ito.
units.backTranslation: Cosmo-Local Credit connects those who offer a product or service, those who need it, and the Pools of Promises that are separately managed and allow for Voucher exchange. This page starts with terms that participants will see, before explaining the technical parts behind them.

units.source: Exact App labels appear in quotation marks where the interface uses a shorter or potentially ambiguous name.
units.translation: Nasa panipi ang eksaktong label ng App kapag gumagamit ang interface ng mas maikli o posibleng malabong pangalan.
units.backTranslation: The exact App label is in the footnote when the interface uses a shorter or possibly more elaborate name.

units.source: ## Everyday terms
units.translation: ## Mga pang-araw-araw na termino
units.backTranslation: ## Everyday terms.

units.source: Term  Plain-language meaning
units.translation: Termino  Payak na kahulugan
units.backTranslation: Term  Simple definition  Definition  Definitions

units.source: Voucher  A transferable commitment—much like a gift card—whose Issuer promises specified goods, services, benefits, or other performance under published terms.
units.translation: Voucher  Isang naililipat na pangako—na parang gift card—kung saan nangangako ang Tagapag-isyu ng tiyak na produkto, serbisyo, benepisyo, o ibang pagtupad ayon sa inilathalang mga tuntunin.
units.backTranslation: Voucher  A transferable promise—like a gift card—in which the Issuer promises a specific product, service, benefit, or other performance under published terms.

units.source: Issuer  The person or organization that creates the Voucher and remains responsible for what it promises.
units.translation: Tagapag-isyu  Ang tao o organisasyong gumagawa ng Voucher at nananatiling responsable sa ipinapangako nito.
units.backTranslation: Issuer  The person or organization that makes the Voucher and remains responsible for its promises.

units.source: Offering  A catalog record describing goods or services associated with a Voucher. It helps people discover the offer but does not prove availability or fulfillment.
units.translation: Offering  Tala sa katalogo na naglalarawan sa produkto o serbisyong kaugnay ng Voucher. Nakatutulong ito upang matuklasan ang alok, ngunit hindi patunay ng availability o pagtupad.
units.backTranslation: Offering  List in the catalogue describing the product or service related to the Voucher. It helps to discover the offer, but does not prove availability or fulfillment.

units.source: Want  A published expression of something a participant is looking for. It does not by itself accept an Offering, reserve goods, authorize an exchange, or create an obligation.
units.translation: Pangangailangan (Want)  Inilathalang pahayag ng hinahanap ng kalahok. Hindi nito, sa sarili nito, tinatanggap ang Offering, inirereserba ang produkto, pinapahintulutan ang palitan, o nililikha ang obligasyon.
units.backTranslation: A published statement of the participant's desire. It does not, in itself, accept the Offering, reserve the product, permit exchange, or create obligation.

units.source: Market  The App's discovery catalog for Vouchers, Pools, Offerings, Wants, and other public information. It is not automatically an exchange venue, seller, endorsement, or guarantee.
units.translation: Pamilihan  Katalogo ng App para sa pagtuklas ng mga Voucher, Pool, Offering, Pangangailangan, at ibang pampublikong impormasyon. Hindi ito awtomatikong lugar ng palitan, nagbebenta, pag-endorso, o garantiya.
units.backTranslation: Marketplace  App catalog for the discovery of Vouchers, Pools, Offerings, Needs, and other public information. It is not an automatic place of exchange, selling, endorsement, or warranty.

units.source: Commitment Pool  A governed arrangement that selects supported Vouchers, publishes exchange rules, holds inventory, and enables exchange. Pool is the ordinary shorthand.
units.translation: Pool ng Pangako (Commitment Pool)  Kaayusang may pamamahala na pumipili ng suportadong Voucher, naglalathala ng mga patakaran sa palitan, humahawak ng imbentaryo, at nagbibigay-daan sa palitan. Karaniwang Pool ang pinaikling tawag.
units.backTranslation: Commitment Pool  A governed system that selects supported Vouchers, publishes exchange policies, maintains inventory, and enables exchange. Commonly abbreviated as the Pool.

units.source: Pool Steward  The accountable person, cooperative, public agency, federation, multisig, service, or other structure that publishes and administers a Pool's rules.
units.translation: Tagapangasiwa ng Pool  Ang tao, kooperatiba, pampublikong ahensiya, pederasyon, multisig, serbisyo, o ibang istrukturang may pananagutan sa paglalathala at pangangasiwa ng mga patakaran ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: Pool Administrator  The person, cooperative, public agency, federation, multisig, service, or other structure responsible for publishing and administering the Pool rules.

units.source: Holder  A participant controlling a Voucher balance. Holding it does not prove fulfillment, cash value, or a guarantee.
units.translation: Mayhawak  Kalahok na kumokontrol sa balanse ng Voucher. Hindi patunay ng pagtupad, halagang cash, o garantiya ang paghawak nito.
units.backTranslation: Holder  The Participant who controls the balance of the Voucher. Its possession does not constitute proof of performance, cash value, or guarantee.

units.source: Wallet  The account and credentials used to authorize token transfers and Pool exchanges.
units.translation: Wallet  Ang account at mga credential na ginagamit upang pahintulutan ang paglilipat ng token at mga palitan sa Pool.
units.backTranslation: Wallet  The account and credentials used to authorize the transfer of tokens and exchanges in the Pool.

units.source: “Community member” is informal social language. It does not by itself create admission, ownership, governance, repayment, or other legal rights.
units.translation: Ang “miyembro ng komunidad” ay impormal na panlipunang tawag. Hindi ito, sa sarili nito, lumilikha ng pagtanggap, pagmamay-ari, pamamahala, pagbabayad, o ibang legal na karapatan.
units.backTranslation: “Community member” is an informal social term. It does not, in itself, create receipt, ownership, management, payment, or other legal rights.

units.source: ## Discovering and contacting participants
units.translation: ## Pagtuklas at pakikipag-ugnayan sa mga kalahok
units.backTranslation: ## Discover and engage with participants.

units.source: The Market helps people find Vouchers, Offerings, Wants, and Pools. A listing means the App can display a record; it does not prove that its information is accurate, that inventory is available, or that a transaction will succeed.
units.translation: Tinutulungan ng Pamilihan ang mga tao na makahanap ng Voucher, Offering, Pangangailangan, at Pool. Ang pagkakalista ay nangangahulugang maipapakita ng App ang tala; hindi nito pinatutunayang tama ang impormasyon, may available na imbentaryo, o magtatagumpay ang transaksyon.
units.backTranslation: The Marketplace helps people find Vouchers, Offerings, Needs, and Pools. A listing means that the App will display the record; it does not confirm that the information is correct, inventory is available, or a transaction will succeed.

units.source: A participant can publish a Want and can contact another participant through the available contact or messaging features. A contact request, message, booking discussion, or response to a Want does not by itself:
units.translation: Maaaring maglathala ng Pangangailangan ang isang kalahok at makipag-ugnayan sa iba gamit ang available na contact o messaging feature. Ang contact request, mensahe, pag-uusap tungkol sa booking, o tugon sa Pangangailangan ay hindi, sa sarili nito:
units.backTranslation: A participant may post a Need and communicate with others using the available contact or messaging feature. The contact request, message, conversation about booking, or response to a Need is not, in itself: it is a response to the Need.

units.source: - accept a Voucher or Offering;
units.translation: - pagtanggap ng Voucher o Offering;
units.backTranslation: - acceptance of the Voucher or Offering;

units.source: - authorize a transfer or Pool swap;
units.translation: - pagpapahintulot sa paglilipat o palitan sa Pool;
units.backTranslation: - authorizing transfers or exchanges in the Pool; allowing transfers of pool members to other pools.

units.source: - prove delivery or satisfaction;
units.translation: - patunay ng paghahatid o kasiyahan;
units.backTranslation: - proof of delivery or satisfaction;

units.source: - fulfill or discharge a Voucher; or
units.translation: - pagtupad o discharge ng Voucher; o
units.backTranslation: - fulfilment or discharge of the Voucher; or

units.source: - make GEF a party to the participants' agreement.
units.translation: - paggawa sa GEF na partido sa kasunduan ng mga kalahok.
units.backTranslation: - working with the GEF as a party to the agreement of participants.

units.source: Reviews are public feedback about a Voucher or Pool. They are not the same as private eligibility evidence, operator due diligence, a guarantee, or a finding that fulfillment occurred.
units.translation: Ang mga Review ay pampublikong puna tungkol sa Voucher o Pool. Iba ang mga ito sa pribadong ebidensiya ng pagiging kwalipikado, due diligence ng operator, garantiya, o pagpapasyang natupad na ang pangako.
units.backTranslation: Reviews are public comments about the Voucher or Pool. They are different from private evidence of eligibility, operator due diligence, guarantees, or decisions that promise has been fulfilled.

units.source: ## Vouchers, tokens, and Offerings
units.translation: ## Mga Voucher, token, at Offering
units.backTranslation: ## Vouchers, Tokens, and Offerings

units.source: A token is an on-chain balance or digital asset. Token mechanics can record supply, transfers, expiry, and burning, but they do not by themselves promise goods, services, cash conversion, or redemption.
units.translation: Ang token ay balanse sa blockchain o digital na asset. Maaaring itala ng mekanismo ng token ang supply, paglilipat, pag-expire, at pag-burn, ngunit hindi ito, sa sarili nito, pangako ng produkto, serbisyo, cash conversion, o pagtubos.
units.backTranslation: The token is balanced on the blockchain or digital asset. The token mechanism may record supply, transfer, expiration, and burn, but it is not, in itself, a promise of product, service, cash conversion, or redemption.

units.source: A Voucher is a token or record that an Issuer represents as a redeemable commitment under published terms. Those terms should identify what is promised, who is responsible, where and when it can be presented, material limits, and the fulfillment and complaint process.
units.translation: Ang Voucher ay token o tala na inilalarawan ng Tagapag-isyu bilang pangakong maaaring tubusin ayon sa inilathalang mga tuntunin. Dapat tukuyin ng mga tuntunin ang ipinapangako, ang responsable, saan at kailan ito maihaharap, mahahalagang limitasyon, at proseso ng pagtupad at reklamo.
units.backTranslation: A Voucher is a token or record described by the Issuer as a pledge redeemable under published terms. The terms should specify what is promised, who is liable, where and when it can be made, material limitations, and processes for performance and complaints.

units.source: An Offering is the catalog record for goods or services associated with a Voucher. In ordinary prose, “offer” simply means something a participant proposes; Offering is the named App record.
units.translation: Ang Offering ay tala sa katalogo ng produkto o serbisyong kaugnay ng Voucher. Sa karaniwang pangungusap, ang “alok” ay isang bagay na iminumungkahi ng kalahok; Offering ang pangalan ng tala sa App.
units.backTranslation: Offering is the entry in the catalog of products or services related to the Voucher. In common phrase, “offer” is something suggested by a participant; Offering the name of the entry on the App.

units.source: Keep these four layers separate:
units.translation: Panatilihing magkahiwalay ang apat na bahaging ito:
units.backTranslation: Keep these four parts separate: 1.

units.source: 1. the token contract and balances;
units.translation: 1. ang token contract at mga balanse;
units.backTranslation: 1. the token contracts and balances; 2. the balances of the tokens;

units.source: 2. the Voucher designation and published terms;
units.translation: 2. ang pagtatalaga bilang Voucher at ang inilathalang mga tuntunin;
units.backTranslation: 2. the designation as a Voucher and the published terms;

units.source: 4. the Issuer's real-world performance.
units.translation: 4. ang aktuwal na pagtupad ng Tagapag-isyu.
units.backTranslation: 4. the actual performance of the Issuer.

units.source: Issuer  Publishes and fulfills a Voucher commitment. This responsibility does not automatically move merely because contract ownership changes.
units.translation: Tagapag-isyu  Naglalathala at tumutupad sa pangako ng Voucher. Hindi awtomatikong naililipat ang pananagutang ito dahil lamang nagbago ang may-ari ng contract.
units.backTranslation: Issuer  Issues and fulfils the promise of the Voucher. This responsibility is not automatically transferred simply because the owner of the contract has changed.

units.source: Pool Steward  Publishes and administers Pool rules and remains accountable for any guarantee the Pool expressly advertises.
units.translation: Tagapangasiwa ng Pool  Naglalathala at nangangasiwa sa mga patakaran ng Pool, at nananatiling responsable sa garantiyang hayagang ipinapahayag ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: Pool Administrator  Publishes and administers the Pool policies, and remains responsible for any warranties expressly made by the Pool.

units.source: Pool owner  The address with current SwapPool owner powers, including configuration, fee collection, and available-liquidity withdrawal.
units.translation: May-ari ng Pool  Address na may kasalukuyang kapangyarihan ng may-ari ng SwapPool, kasama ang configuration, pagkolekta ng bayarin, at pag-withdraw ng magagamit na liquidity.
units.backTranslation: Pool Owner  Address with current SwapPool owner powers, including configuration, fee collection, and withdrawal of available liquidity.

units.source: Multisig signers  Share the technical authority assigned to a multisig Wallet. Changing signers or thresholds does not silently transfer Issuer responsibility, Steward accountability, or legal ownership.
units.translation: Mga multisig signer  Naghahati sa teknikal na awtoridad na itinalaga sa multisig Wallet. Ang pagbabago ng signer o threshold ay hindi palihim na paglilipat ng pananagutan ng Tagapag-isyu o Tagapangasiwa, o ng legal na pagmamay-ari.
units.backTranslation: Multisig Signers  Divides the technical authority assigned to the multisig Wallet. Changing the signer or threshold is not a secret transfer of responsibility by the Issuer or Administrator, or legal owner.

units.source: Proxy administrator  Can upgrade a proxied contract implementation. It may differ from the Pool owner.
units.translation: Proxy administrator  Maaaring mag-upgrade ng implementation ng proxied contract. Maaaring iba ito sa may-ari ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: Proxy administrator  Can upgrade the implementation of the proxy contract. This may be different from the Pool owner.

units.source: Dependency controller  Controls a registry, limiter, quoter, oracle, fee policy, or protocol-fee controller.
units.translation: Dependency controller  Kumokontrol sa registry, limiter, quoter, oracle, patakaran sa bayarin, o controller ng bayarin sa protocol.
units.backTranslation: Dependency controller  Controls the registry, limiter, quoter, oracle, charge policy, or protocol charge controller.

units.source: Catalog moderator  Can correct, hide, retire, or restore catalog records without deleting contracts, balances, or chain history.
units.translation: Tagapangasiwa ng katalogo  Maaaring magwasto, magtago, mag-retire, o magbalik ng tala sa katalogo nang hindi binubura ang mga contract, balanse, o kasaysayan sa blockchain.
units.backTranslation: Catalog Administrators  Can spend, hide, retire, or restore records to the catalog without deleting contracts, balances, or history on the blockchain.

units.source: Fee recipient  Receives a configured Pool or protocol fee. It is not necessarily the Pool Steward or owner.
units.translation: Tatanggap ng bayarin  Tumatanggap ng naka-configure na bayarin sa Pool o protocol. Hindi ito kinakailangang Tagapangasiwa o may-ari ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: Payer  Accepts the configured payment in the Pool or protocol. This does not need to be an Administrator or Pool owner.

units.source: Supporter or liquidity provider  Contributes assets under separately disclosed terms. The current SwapPool creates no automatic Pool shares, repayment, withdrawal, reward, or governance rights.
units.translation: Tagasuporta o liquidity provider  Nag-aambag ng asset sa ilalim ng hiwalay na isiniwalat na mga tuntunin. Hindi awtomatikong lumilikha ang kasalukuyang SwapPool ng bahagi sa Pool o karapatan sa pagbabayad, withdrawal, reward, o pamamahala.
units.backTranslation: Supporter or liquidity provider  Contributes assets under separately disclosed terms. The current SwapPool does not automatically create a share in the Pool or rights to payment, withdrawal, reward, or management.

units.source: Create or publish a Voucher  Deploy or configure a token and publish its catalog record and terms.
units.translation: Gumawa o maglathala ng Voucher  Mag-deploy o mag-configure ng token at ilathala ang tala nito sa katalogo at mga tuntunin.
units.backTranslation: Create or Publish Voucher  Deploy or configure a token and publish its entry in the catalog and terms.

units.source: Publish an Offering  Add a goods or services record beneath a Voucher.
units.translation: Maglathala ng Offering  Magdagdag ng tala ng produkto o serbisyo sa ilalim ng Voucher.
units.backTranslation: Publish Offering  Add a product or service entry under the Voucher.

units.source: Publish a Want  Describe a need for discovery and possible contact; it does not itself create a transaction.
units.translation: Maglathala ng Pangangailangan  Ilarawan ang kailangan upang matuklasan at posibleng makaugnayan; hindi ito, sa sarili nito, lumilikha ng transaksyon.
units.backTranslation: Publish a Need  Identify the need to discover and potentially engage; it does not, in itself, create a transaction.

units.source: Send  Transfer a token balance to another address.
units.translation: Ipadala  Ilipat ang balanse ng token sa ibang address.
units.backTranslation: Send  Transfer the token balance to another address.

units.source: “Redeem”  Open the send flow with the token owner's address prefilled. This is redemption presentment; it does not prove fulfillment.
units.translation: “Tubusin”  Buksan ang pagpapadala na nakalagay na ang address ng may-ari ng token. Paghaharap ito para sa pagtubos, hindi patunay ng pagtupad.
units.backTranslation: “Redeem”  Open the shipment that states the address of the token owner. This is a presentation for redemption, not proof of delivery.

units.source: Fulfill  The Issuer provides the promised goods, services, benefits, or other performance.
units.translation: Tumupad  Ibigay ng Tagapag-isyu ang ipinangakong produkto, serbisyo, benepisyo, o ibang pagtupad.
units.backTranslation: Fulfill  The Issuer delivers the promised product, service, benefit, or other fulfilment.

units.source: Discharge  Record fulfilled units so they cannot be presented again, for example by receiving, burning, cancelling, or otherwise disabling them under the published terms.
units.translation: Discharge  Itala ang mga natupad nang yunit upang hindi maiharap muli, halimbawa sa pagtanggap, pag-burn, pagkansela, o ibang paraan ng pagpapahinto sa paggamit ayon sa inilathalang mga tuntunin.
units.backTranslation: Discharge  Record completed units so that they are not submitted again, for example by receipt, burning, cancellation, or other means of discontinuing use in accordance with the published terms.
