units.source: “Request retirement”  The current owner asks an administrator to retire a Voucher or Pool. The resource remains active while the request is pending, and the request may be approved, rejected, or cancelled.
units.translation: “Humiling ng pag-retire”  Hilingin ng kasalukuyang may-ari sa administrator ang pag-retire ng Voucher o Pool. Aktibo pa rin ang resource habang nakabinbin ang hiling, at maaaring aprubahan, tanggihan, o kanselahin ang hiling.
units.backTranslation: “Request Retirement”  The current owner asks the administrator to retire the Voucher or Pool. The resource remains active while the request is pending, and can approve, reject, or cancel the request.

units.source: Retire a Voucher  After approval, remove the Voucher from active catalog use. Contracts, balances, obligations, and history remain; retirement is not burning or discharge.
units.translation: I-retire ang Voucher  Kapag naaprubahan, alisin ang Voucher sa aktibong paggamit sa katalogo. Nananatili ang mga contract, balanse, obligasyon, at kasaysayan; hindi pag-burn o discharge ang pag-retire.
units.backTranslation: Retire Voucher  Once approved, remove the actively used Voucher from the catalog. Contracts, balances, obligations and history are preserved; retirement does not burn or discharge.

units.source: Retire a Pool  After approval, stop new Pool swaps and deposits while allowing available withdrawals. Prior settlement records remain.
units.translation: I-retire ang Pool  Kapag naaprubahan, ihinto ang mga bagong palitan at deposito sa Pool habang pinapayagan ang available na withdrawal. Nananatili ang mga naunang tala ng settlement.
units.backTranslation: Retire Pool  Once approved, stop new exchanges and deposits into the Pool while allowing available withdrawals. Previous settlement records are retained.

units.source: Pool deposit or contribution  Transfer assets into a SwapPool. Repayment, withdrawal, reward, or governance rights exist only when separately disclosed.
units.translation: Deposito o kontribusyon sa Pool  Ilipat ang mga asset sa SwapPool. May karapatan lamang sa pagbabayad, withdrawal, reward, o pamamahala kapag hiwalay itong isiniwalat.
units.backTranslation: Deposit or Contribute to Pool  Transfer assets into the SwapPool. Rights to payment, withdrawal, reward, or management only when separately disclosed.

units.source: Pool swap  Exchange supported assets through one SwapPool. This is neither Issuer fulfillment nor automatically a loan.
units.translation: Palitan sa Pool  Ipagpalit ang suportadong mga asset sa isang SwapPool. Hindi ito pagtupad ng Tagapag-isyu o awtomatikong pautang.
units.backTranslation: Swap in Pool  Exchange supported assets in a SwapPool. This is not Issuer performance or automatic loan.

units.source: Route discovery  Find possible paths through configured Pool relationships. Discovery is an estimate, not an executable promise.
units.translation: Pagtuklas ng ruta  Maghanap ng posibleng daan sa mga naka-configure na ugnayan ng Pool. Tantiya ang pagtuklas, hindi pangakong maisasagawa.
units.backTranslation: Route Discovery  Finds possible paths in the configured Pool connections. Discovery is an estimate, not a promise.

units.source: Route quote  Calculate a time-bounded proposal from Pool state read at one pinned block and simulate it before signing.
units.translation: Quote ng ruta  Kalkulahin ang panukalang may takdang bisa mula sa estado ng Pool na binasa sa iisang pinned block, at i-simulate ito bago pumirma.
units.backTranslation: Route Quote  Calculate the final proposal from the Pool state read to a single pinned block, and simulate it before signing.

units.source: Routed exchange  Submit an ordered set of Pool swaps as one same-chain Wallet batch. In the current flow, every call reverts if any call fails.
units.translation: Routed exchange  Isumite ang sunod-sunod na palitan sa Pool bilang isang Wallet batch sa iisang chain. Sa kasalukuyang daloy, nababawi ang lahat ng call kapag may isang nabigo.
units.backTranslation: Routed exchange  Submit the sequential exchange to the Pool as a Wallet batch on a single chain. In current flow, all calls are cancelled when there is one failure.

units.source: Routed-exchange receipt  Group the tracking status, transaction hash, route hops, settled amounts, and per-hop fees.
units.translation: Resibo ng routed exchange  Pagsamahin ang tracking status, transaction hash, mga hop ng ruta, settled na halaga, at mga bayarin sa bawat hop.
units.backTranslation: Routed exchange receipt  Includes tracking status, transaction hash, route hops, settled amounts, and fees per hop.

units.source: Pool liquidity withdrawal  Let the Pool owner transfer available inventory to a selected address.
units.translation: Pag-withdraw ng liquidity sa Pool  Hayaan ang may-ari ng Pool na ilipat ang magagamit na imbentaryo sa piniling address.
units.backTranslation: Withdrawing liquidity from the Pool  Let the Pool owner move available inventory to the selected address.

units.source: Fee collection  Send accrued Pool fees to the configured recipient.
units.translation: Pagkolekta ng bayarin  Ipadala ang naipong bayarin sa Pool sa naka-configure na tatanggap.
units.backTranslation: Collect Fee  Send the collected fee to the Pool to the configured recipient.

units.source: Use swap settlement for the on-chain transfers and fee accounting that complete a Pool swap. Use redemption presentment, fulfillment, and discharge for the separate real-world Voucher lifecycle.
units.translation: Gamitin ang swap settlement para sa mga paglilipat sa blockchain at pagtatala ng bayarin na kumukumpleto sa palitan sa Pool. Gamitin ang paghaharap para sa pagtubos, pagtupad, at discharge para sa hiwalay na lifecycle ng Voucher sa aktuwal na buhay.
units.backTranslation: Use swap settlement for blockchain transfers and record fees that are completed in exchange to the Pool. Use dealing for redemption, fulfillment, and discharge for separate real-life Voucher lifecycles.

units.source: ## Product and protocol layers
units.translation: ## Mga layer ng produkto at protokol
units.backTranslation: ## Product and protocol layers

units.source: Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC)  The product family: the CLC App, its documentation, and the wider commitment-pooling work.
units.translation: Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC)  Ang pamilya ng produkto: CLC App, dokumentasyon nito, at mas malawak na gawain sa commitment pooling.
units.backTranslation: Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC)  The product family: CLC App, its documentation, and the broader commitment pooling work.

units.source: CLC App  The progressive web app at cosmolocal.credit. GEF operates this interface and its supporting services.
units.translation: CLC App  Ang progressive web app sa cosmolocal.credit. Pinapatakbo ng GEF ang interface na ito at mga sumusuportang serbisyo nito.
units.backTranslation: CLC App  The progressive web app on cosmolocal.credit. This interface and its supporting services are operated by GEF.

units.source: CLC Core  The supporting service for catalogs, indexed chain state, route discovery, authoritative quotes, relay coordination, and routed-exchange receipts. It is neither a smart contract nor a Pool Steward.
units.translation: CLC Core  Sumusuportang serbisyo para sa mga katalogo, indexed chain state, pagtuklas ng ruta, may-awtoridad na quote, relay coordination, at mga resibo ng routed exchange. Hindi ito smart contract o Tagapangasiwa ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: CLC Core  Supporting services for catalogs, indexed chain state, route discovery, authoritative quote, relay coordination, and routed exchange receipts. Not a smart contract or Pool Administrator.

units.source: Commitment Pooling Protocol (CPP)  The reusable model of curation, valuation, limitation, exchange, and accountable governance.
units.translation: Commitment Pooling Protocol (CPP)  Ang magagamit-muling modelo ng pagpili, valuation, paglilimita, palitan, at pamamahalang may pananagutan.
units.backTranslation: Commitment Pooling Protocol (CPP)  The renewable model of selection, valuation, limitation, exchange and accountable management.

units.source: Protocol v1.1.0  The public smart-contract release documented in the definitive software reference (English).
units.translation: Protocol v1.1.0  Ang pampublikong release ng mga smart contract na nakadokumento sa pangunahing sanggunian sa software (Ingles).
units.backTranslation: Protocol v1.1.0  The public release of the smart contracts documented in the main software reference.

units.source: SwapPool  The current Protocol contract that holds token inventory and executes direct swaps. It is one technical component of a Commitment Pool.
units.translation: SwapPool  Ang kasalukuyang contract ng Protokol na humahawak ng imbentaryo ng token at nagsasagawa ng direktang palitan. Isa itong teknikal na bahagi ng Pool ng Pangako.
units.backTranslation: SwapPool  The current contract of the Protocol that holds the token inventory and performs direct exchange. It is a technical part of the Pool of Promises.

units.source: Solidity SwapRouter  The Protocol v1.1.0 contract that quotes a proposed multi-Pool path. It does not custody assets or execute the route.
units.translation: Solidity SwapRouter  Ang contract ng Protocol v1.1.0 na nagku-quote ng iminungkahing daan sa maraming Pool. Hindi ito humahawak ng mga asset o nagsasagawa ng ruta.
units.backTranslation: Solidity SwapRouter  The Protocol v1.1.0 contract that quotes the proposed route to multiple Pools. It does not hold assets or execute the route.

units.source: Application routing workflow  The App and supporting services find possible paths through Pools, quote an exchange, request the participant's authorization, and report the result.
units.translation: Daloy ng routing sa application  Naghahanap ang App at mga sumusuportang serbisyo ng posibleng daan sa mga Pool, nagku-quote ng palitan, humihingi ng pahintulot ng kalahok, at nag-uulat ng resulta.
units.backTranslation: In-application routing flow  The App and supporting services search for possible routes to Pools, quote the exchange, request permission from participants, and report the results.

units.source: Proposed CLC governance token  A future governance design in the White Paper. It is not a current App or Protocol v1.1.0 asset.
units.translation: Iminungkahing CLC governance token  Disenyo para sa pamamahala sa hinaharap na nasa White Paper. Hindi ito kasalukuyang asset ng App o Protocol v1.1.0.
units.backTranslation: Proposed CLC governance token  Design for future governance in the White Paper. This is not a current asset of App or Protocol v1.1.0.

units.source: Proposed CLC Network Pool  A future network-level clearing and coordination design. It is not the same as a current SwapPool.
units.translation: Iminungkahing CLC Network Pool  Disenyo para sa clearing at koordinasyon sa antas ng network sa hinaharap. Iba ito sa kasalukuyang SwapPool.
units.backTranslation: Proposed CLC Network Pool  Design for future network-level clearing and coordination. It is different from the current SwapPool.

units.source: ## Values, credit, limits, and fees
units.translation: ## Halaga, kredito, limitasyon, at bayarin
units.backTranslation: ## Value, credit, limits, and charges

units.source: Keep these value terms separate:
units.translation: Pag-ibahin ang mga terminong ito sa halaga:
units.backTranslation: Divide these terms into value: Value: The amount of money that is required to purchase a product.

units.source: - Offering price: the amount requested for a listed good or service;
units.translation: - Presyo ng Offering: ang halagang hinihingi para sa nakalistang produkto o serbisyo;
units.backTranslation: - Offering Price: the amount requested for the listed product or service;

units.source: - Voucher stated value: a value represented in the Issuer's published terms;
units.translation: - Nakasaad na halaga ng Voucher: ang halagang inilalarawan sa inilathalang mga tuntunin ng Tagapag-isyu;
units.backTranslation: - Voucher's stated value: the amount described in the published terms of the Issuer;

units.source: - Pool exchange rate or quote: the transaction parameter produced by a Pool's configured quoter;
units.translation: - Rate ng palitan o quote ng Pool: ang parameter ng transaksyon mula sa naka-configure na quoter ng Pool;
units.backTranslation: - Exchange rate or Pool quote: the transaction parameter from the configured Pool quoter; - Pool price: the price of the pool.

units.source: - oracle reference: external data used by a configured valuation module; and
units.translation: - Sanggunian ng oracle: panlabas na datos na ginagamit ng naka-configure na valuation module; at
units.backTranslation: - Oracle references: external data used by the configured valuation module; and

units.source: - redemption terms: what the Issuer promises and under what conditions.
units.translation: - Mga tuntunin sa pagtubos: ano ang ipinapangako ng Tagapag-isyu at sa anong mga kondisyon.
units.backTranslation: - Redemption terms: what the Issuer promises and under what conditions.

units.source: Credit in the App refers to reachable commitments and exchange capacity. It is not automatically personal borrowing, a loan, an Issuer-capacity assessment, or a guarantee.
units.translation: Ang Kredito sa App ay tumutukoy sa maaabot na mga pangako at kapasidad sa palitan. Hindi ito awtomatikong personal na pangungutang, pautang, pagtatasa ng kakayahan ng Tagapag-isyu, o garantiya.
units.backTranslation: App Credit refers to achievable commitments and capacity for exchange. It is not automatically personal borrowing, loan, assessment of the Issuer's ability, or guarantee.

units.source: The label “Credit limit” means the Pool's configured token-balance cap: the maximum amount of that token the Pool may hold after a deposit. Proposed rolling, account, and network-wide limits in the White Paper are different mechanisms.
units.translation: Ang label na “Credit limit” ay ang naka-configure na token-balance cap ng Pool: ang pinakamataas na dami ng token na maaari nitong hawakan pagkatapos ng deposito. Ibang mekanismo ang iminungkahing rolling limit, account limit, at network-wide limit sa White Paper.
units.backTranslation: The “Credit limit” label is the Pool’s configured token-balance cap: the maximum amount of token it can hold after deposit. Other mechanisms are the rolling limit, account limit, and network-wide limit proposed in the White Paper.

units.source: Protocol v1.1.0 can charge a Pool fee and an additional protocol fee on each Pool swap. A routed exchange itemizes both for every hop. The current App adds no separate routing-service fee. The proposed White Paper model separately describes a future network rake and possible service fees.
units.translation: Maaaring maningil ang Protocol v1.1.0 ng bayarin sa Pool at karagdagang bayarin sa protocol sa bawat palitan sa Pool. Inililista ng routed exchange ang dalawa sa bawat hop. Walang hiwalay na routing-service fee ang kasalukuyang App. Hiwalay na inilalarawan ng iminungkahing modelo sa White Paper ang bahagi ng bayarin para sa network sa hinaharap at mga posibleng service fee.
units.backTranslation: The Protocol v1.1.0 may charge a Pool fee and additional protocol fees on each exchange in the Pool. The routed exchange lists two per hop. There is no separate routing-service fee for the current App. The proposed model in the White Paper describes separately the part of the fee for future network and possible service fees.

units.source: ## Routes and liquidity
units.translation: ## Mga ruta at liquidity
units.backTranslation: ## Routes and liquidity ##

units.source: A route is an ordered path through one or more independently governed Pools. Route depth is the number of Pool swaps in that path.
units.translation: Ang ruta ay nakaayos na daan sa isa o higit pang Pool na magkakahiwalay ang pamamahala. Ang lalim ng ruta ay bilang ng mga palitan sa Pool sa daang iyon.
units.backTranslation: A route is an organized path in one or more separately managed Pools. The route depth is the number of Pool exchanges on that path.

units.source: Not every Voucher, Pool, or Wallet is eligible for routing. Appearing in a Pool does not automatically make a Voucher available through every route. The software routing reference maintains the current eligibility rules and configuration in English.
units.translation: Hindi lahat ng Voucher, Pool, o Wallet ay kwalipikado sa routing. Hindi awtomatikong nagiging available ang Voucher sa lahat ng ruta dahil nasa isang Pool ito. Pinananatili sa sanggunian sa routing ng software ang kasalukuyang mga tuntunin sa pagiging kwalipikado at configuration, sa Ingles.
units.backTranslation: Not all Vouchers, Pools, or Wallets are eligible for routing. The fact that a Voucher is in a Pool does not automatically make it available on all routes. The current terms of eligibility and configuration are maintained in the software routing reference.

units.source: Available liquidity is the inventory a Pool can supply under its current rules, limits, and fees. A connection between Pools does not prove that the amount you want is available. Review the final quote; it can expire or become invalid if Pool conditions change.
units.translation: Ang magagamit na liquidity ay ang imbentaryong maibibigay ng Pool sa ilalim ng kasalukuyang mga patakaran, limitasyon, at bayarin nito. Hindi patunay ang koneksyon sa pagitan ng mga Pool na available ang halagang gusto mo. Suriin ang huling quote; maaari itong mag-expire o mawalan ng bisa kung magbago ang kalagayan ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: Available liquidity is the inventory that the Pool can provide under its current rules, limits and fees. The connection between the Pools does not prove that the amount you want is available. Check the last quote; it may expire or become invalid if the status of the Pool changes.

units.source: Current route execution is same-chain and Wallet-initiated. It does not pool governance, automatically rebalance Pool inventory, clear obligations among many parties, or prove fulfillment. Cross-chain HTLC or escrow routing, automatic rebalancing, and batch netting remain proposed or deployment-dependent.
units.translation: Sa kasalukuyan, sa iisang chain at mula sa Wallet isinasagawa ang ruta. Hindi nito pinagsasama ang pamamahala, awtomatikong binabalanse ang imbentaryo ng Pool, isinasagawa ang clearing ng mga obligasyon ng maraming partido, o pinatutunayan ang pagtupad. Nananatiling iminungkahi o nakadepende sa deployment ang cross-chain HTLC o escrow routing, awtomatikong pagbabalanse, at batch netting.
units.backTranslation: Currently, routing is done in a single chain and from the Wallet. It does not consolidate management, automatically balance Pool inventory, clear multi-party obligations, or verify compliance. Cross-chain HTLC or escrow routing, automatic balancing, and batch netting remain suggested or deployment dependent.

units.source: Curation, registry inclusion, a limit, a reserve, App visibility, a Review, or a blockchain transaction does not by itself establish endorsement, Issuer capacity, fulfillment, a guarantee, or insurance.
units.translation: Ang pagpili, pagkakasama sa registry, limitasyon, reserba, visibility sa App, Review, o transaksyon sa blockchain ay hindi, sa sarili nito, patunay ng pag-endorso, kakayahan ng Tagapag-isyu, pagtupad, garantiya, o insurance.
units.backTranslation: The selection, inclusion in the registry, limitation, reservation, visibility on the App, Review, or transaction on the blockchain is not, in itself, evidence of endorsement, ability of the Issuer, performance, warranty, or insurance.

units.source: Any protection should identify the obligated party, covered event, funding, cap, exclusions, duration, evidence, and claim process. On-chain records can show addresses, assets, amounts, timestamps, and contract events. Issuer performance, satisfaction, governance deliberation, and social impact require separate evidence.
units.translation: Dapat tukuyin ng anumang proteksyon ang may obligasyon, saklaw na pangyayari, pondo, cap, mga hindi saklaw, tagal, ebidensiya, at proseso ng claim. Maaaring ipakita ng mga tala sa blockchain ang mga address, asset, halaga, timestamp, at event ng contract. Kailangan ng hiwalay na ebidensiya ang pagtupad ng Tagapag-isyu, kasiyahan, pagtalakay sa pamamahala, at epekto sa lipunan.
units.backTranslation: Any protection must specify the liability, covered events, funds, caps, exclusions, duration, evidence, and claim process. Blockchain records can show addresses, assets, values, timestamps, and contract events. Issuer compliance, satisfaction, governance discussions, and social impact require separate evidence.

units.source: - Deployment-dependent: available only where a particular deployment, Pool, provider, jurisdiction, or published policy enables it.
units.translation: - Nakadepende sa deployment: available lamang kung pinapagana ng partikular na deployment, Pool, provider, hurisdiksiyon, o inilathalang patakaran.
units.backTranslation: - Deployment-dependent: available only if enabled by a particular deployment, pool, provider, jurisdiction, or published policy.

units.source: - Historical: evidence or functionality from the earlier Sarafu Network service.
units.translation: - Makasaysayan: ebidensiya o kakayahan mula sa naunang serbisyong Sarafu Network.
units.backTranslation: - Historical: evidence or capability from previous services of the Sarafu Network.

units.source: - Proposed: a design or roadmap mechanism that is not represented as deployed.
units.translation: - Iminungkahi: disenyo o mekanismo sa roadmap na hindi inilalarawang deployed na.
units.backTranslation: - Suggested: designs or mechanisms in the roadmap that are not described as deployed.

units.source: The Getting started guide applies these terms to the current App. The Protocol overview connects these concepts to the definitive software documentation, while the White Paper presents the wider design and proposals.
units.translation: Inilalapat ng gabay sa pagsisimula ang mga terminong ito sa kasalukuyang App. Iniuugnay ng pangkalahatang-ideya ng Protokol ang mga konsepto sa pangunahing dokumentasyon ng software, samantalang inilalahad ng White Paper ang mas malawak na disenyo at mga panukala.
units.backTranslation: The Getting Started Guide applies these terms to the current App. The Protocol Overview links concepts to core software documentation, while the White Paper outlines broader design and proposals.

units.source: For a learn-through-play introduction to commitments, settlement, resource flows, exchange, and pooling, explore the Grassroots Economics educational games. The games are supplementary learning resources, not definitions of current App or Protocol behavior.
units.translation: Para matutuhan sa paglalaro ang mga pangako, settlement, daloy ng resource, palitan, at pooling, subukan ang mga larong pang-edukasyon ng Grassroots Economics. Karagdagang sanggunian sa pag-aaral ang mga laro, hindi depinisyon ng kasalukuyang kilos ng App o Protokol.
units.backTranslation: To playfully learn about pledges, settlements, resource flows, exchanges, and pooling, try Grassroots Economics educational games. The games are additional learning references, not definitions of the current App or Protocol actions.

units.source: # Voucher exchange examples
units.translation: # Mga halimbawa ng palitan ng Voucher
units.backTranslation: # Examples of Voucher exchanges

units.source: These examples show how Vouchers, Wants, Pools, exchange, fulfillment, and discharge remain connected but distinct. They illustrate the roles involved; they do not promise that a particular Voucher, Pool, route, or outcome will be available.
units.translation: Ipinapakita ng mga halimbawang ito kung paano magkaugnay ngunit magkakaiba ang mga Voucher, Pangangailangan, Pool, palitan, pagtupad, at discharge. Inilalarawan nila ang mga tungkulin; hindi nila ipinapangakong available ang isang partikular na Voucher, Pool, ruta, o resulta.
units.backTranslation: These examples show how Voucher, Need, Pool, exchange, fulfilment, and discharge are related but distinct. They describe roles; they do not promise the availability of a particular Voucher/Pool/route/outcome.

units.source: For definitions used here, see Concepts and vocabulary.
units.translation: Para sa mga kahulugan, tingnan ang Mga konsepto at bokabularyo.
units.backTranslation: For definitions, see Concepts and vocabulary.

units.source: ## Simple example: one Pool, three participants
units.translation: ## Simpleng halimbawa: isang Pool, tatlong kalahok
units.backTranslation: ## Simple example: a Pool, three participants.

units.source: A farmer offers food baskets and needs dental care. A mechanic offers vehicle repair and needs food. A dentist offers dental care and needs vehicle repair.
units.translation: Nag-aalok ang isang magsasaka ng mga basket ng pagkain at nangangailangan ng serbisyong dental. Nag-aalok ang isang mekaniko ng pagkukumpuni ng sasakyan at nangangailangan ng pagkain. Nag-aalok ang isang dentista ng serbisyong dental at nangangailangan ng pagkukumpuni ng sasakyan.
units.backTranslation: A farmer offers food baskets and needs dental services. A mechanic offers car repairs and requires food. A dentist offers dental services and require a car repair.

units.source: Each participant creates a Voucher with clear terms and publishes an Offering:
units.translation: Bawat kalahok ay gumagawa ng Voucher na may malinaw na tuntunin at naglalathala ng Offering:
units.backTranslation: Each participant makes a Voucher with clear terms and publishes the Offering:

units.source: - the farmer's Voucher can be used for food baskets;
units.translation: - magagamit ang Voucher ng magsasaka para sa mga basket ng pagkain;
units.backTranslation: - Farmers Voucher available for food baskets; farmers voucher available to the local government

units.source: - the mechanic's Voucher can be used for repair services; and
units.translation: - magagamit ang Voucher ng mekaniko para sa pagkukumpuni; at
units.backTranslation: - the mechanic's Voucher is available for repair; and

units.source: - the dentist's Voucher can be used for dental care.
units.translation: - magagamit ang Voucher ng dentista para sa serbisyong dental.
units.backTranslation: - the dentist's Voucher is available for dental services.

units.source: The dentist creates a Health Market Commitment Pool, publishes its rules, admits all three Vouchers, and deposits some dental-care Vouchers. The Pool's configured token-balance caps define how many farmer and mechanic Vouchers it may hold. These App “Credit limits” are Pool capacity controls, not personal loans.
units.translation: Gumagawa ang dentista ng Pool ng Pangako na Health Market, naglalathala ng mga patakaran, tumatanggap ng tatlong Voucher, at nagdedeposito ng ilang Voucher sa serbisyong dental. Tinutukoy ng naka-configure na token-balance cap ng Pool kung gaano karaming Voucher ng magsasaka at mekaniko ang maaari nitong hawakan. Mga kontrol sa kapasidad ng Pool ang “Credit limit” na ito sa App, hindi personal na pautang.
units.backTranslation: The dentist runs the Health Market Promise Pool, publishes policies, receives three Vouchers, and deposits some Voucher to dental service. The configured token-balance cap of the Pool determines how many Farmer and Mechanic Voucher it can handle. This “Credit limit” in the App controls the capacity of the pool, not personal loans.

units.source: The farmer sees the dentist's Want for local food, reviews the dentist's Voucher and Pool terms, and exchanges food-basket Vouchers for dental-care Vouchers. The farmer then books an appointment, presents the dental-care Vouchers, receives the promised care, and the dentist records discharge.
units.translation: Nakikita ng magsasaka ang Pangangailangan ng dentista para sa lokal na pagkain, sinusuri ang mga tuntunin ng Voucher at Pool ng dentista, at ipinagpapalit ang Voucher sa basket ng pagkain para sa Voucher sa serbisyong dental. Pagkatapos, nagpapa-appointment ang magsasaka, inihaharap ang Voucher, tumatanggap ng ipinangakong pangangalaga, at itinatala ng dentista ang discharge.
units.backTranslation: The farmer sees the Dentist’s Need for Local Food, reviews the Voucher and Dentist Pool terms, and exchanges the Vehicle with a food basket for a dental service Voucher. Then, the farmer makes an appointment, presents the voucher, receives the promised care, and the dentist records the discharge.

units.source: The mechanic exchanges repair-service Vouchers for the food-basket Vouchers now held by the Pool and uses them for food delivery. The dentist can exchange dental-care Vouchers for the mechanic's repair Vouchers and use them to repair a vehicle.
units.translation: Ipinagpapalit ng mekaniko ang Voucher sa pagkukumpuni para sa Voucher sa basket ng pagkain na hawak na ngayon ng Pool, at ginagamit ito para sa paghahatid ng pagkain. Maaaring ipalit ng dentista ang Voucher sa serbisyong dental sa Voucher ng mekaniko at gamitin iyon upang ipaayos ang sasakyan.
units.backTranslation: The mechanic exchanges the repair voucher for the food basket voucher currently held by the Pool, and uses it for delivery of food. The dentist can exchange the dental service voucher with the mechanic’s voucher and use that to fix the vehicle.

units.source: Each Pool swap settles Voucher balances. Each Issuer remains separately responsible for providing the promised food, repair, or dental care. The Pool makes multilateral exchange possible without requiring each pair to want exactly the same thing at the same time.
units.translation: Bawat palitan sa Pool ay nagsesettle ng mga balanse ng Voucher. Hiwalay na nananatiling responsable ang bawat Tagapag-isyu sa ipinangakong pagkain, pagkukumpuni, o serbisyong dental. Nagbibigay-daan ang Pool sa pagpapalitan ng maraming panig nang hindi kailangang magkatugma sa parehong oras ang gusto ng bawat pares.
units.backTranslation: Each exchange in the Pool settles Voucher balances. Each Issuer remains separately responsible for the promised food, repair, or dental services. The Pool allows multiple-sided exchange without having to match the wishes of each pair at the same time.

units.source: ## Advanced example: a routed exchange
units.translation: ## Mas advanced na halimbawa: routed exchange
units.backTranslation: ## More advanced example: routed exchange.

units.source: This example follows a Voucher from an Offering and a Want through two independently governed Pools.
units.translation: Sinusundan ng halimbawang ito ang isang Voucher mula sa Offering at Pangangailangan hanggang sa palitan sa dalawang Pool na magkakahiwalay ang pamamahala.
units.backTranslation: This example follows a Voucher from Offering and Requirement to exchange in two separately managed Pools.

units.source: ### 1. An Issuer publishes a commitment
units.translation: ### 1. Naglalathala ng pangako ang Tagapag-isyu
units.backTranslation: ### 1. The Issuer issues the pledge.

units.source: Imagine a community kitchen creates a digital meal voucher. Before issuing it, the kitchen publishes information a holder needs to make an informed decision:
units.translation: Ipagpalagay na gumawa ang kusina ng komunidad ng digital na Voucher para sa pagkain. Bago mag-isyu, inilalathala nito ang impormasyong kailangan ng Mayhawak upang makapagpasya nang may kaalaman:
units.backTranslation: Suppose the community kitchen makes a digital Voucher for food. Before issuing, it publishes the information that the Holder needs to make an informed decision:

units.source: - the kitchen's identity and contact details;
units.translation: - pagkakakilanlan at contact detail ng kusina;
units.backTranslation: - identity and contact details of the kitchen;

units.source: - the meal or other Offering represented by one voucher;
units.translation: - ang pagkain o ibang Offering na kinakatawan ng bawat Voucher;
units.backTranslation: - the food or other Offering represented by each Voucher; - the amount of each Vehicle,

units.source: - supply, unit, stated value, and the kitchen's capacity to perform;
units.translation: - supply, yunit, nakasaad na halaga, at kakayahan ng kusina na tumupad;
units.backTranslation: - supply, unit, stated value, and kitchen capacity to meet;

units.source: - where and during what hours it can be presented;
units.translation: - saan at sa anong oras ito maihaharap;
units.backTranslation: - where and at what time it can be presented;

units.source: - any expiry date, booking process, fees, taxes, or transfer restrictions; and
units.translation: - pag-expire, proseso ng booking, bayarin, buwis, o paghihigpit sa paglilipat; at
units.backTranslation: - expiration, booking process, fees, taxes, or transfer restrictions; and

units.source: - how presentment, fulfillment, complaints, refunds, substitutions, and other remedies work.
units.translation: - paano hinahawakan ang paghaharap, pagtupad, reklamo, refund, pagpapalit, at ibang remedyo.
units.backTranslation: - how to handle submission, enforcement, complaints, refunds, replacements, and other remedies.

units.source: The kitchen is the issuer. It must keep this information accurate, avoid issuing beyond its reasonable capacity, and honor vouchers according to the terms under which holders acquired them. Creating the token or publishing the Offering does not prove that capacity or make GEF the issuer.
units.translation: Ang kusina ang Tagapag-isyu. Dapat nitong panatilihing tama ang impormasyon, umiwas sa pag-isyu nang higit sa makatuwirang kaya nitong ibigay, at tuparin ang mga Voucher ayon sa mga tuntuning naaangkop noong nakuha ang mga ito. Hindi patunay ng kakayahan ang paggawa ng token o paglalathala ng Offering, at hindi nito ginagawang Tagapag-isyu ang GEF.
units.backTranslation: The kitchen is the Issuer. It must keep information accurate, avoid issuing more than it can reasonably provide, and honour Vouchers in accordance with the terms applicable when they were obtained. The making of a token or publication of an Offering does not prove competence, and does not make GEF the Issuers.

units.source: The kitchen also publishes an Offering describing the meals available. The voucher and Offering are related but distinct: the voucher is the redeemable commitment, while the Offering helps people discover the goods or services associated with it.
units.translation: Naglalathala rin ang kusina ng Offering na naglalarawan sa mga available na pagkain. Magkaugnay ngunit magkaiba ang Voucher at Offering: pangakong maaaring tubusin ang Voucher, samantalang tinutulungan ng Offering ang mga tao na makita ang kaugnay na produkto o serbisyo.
units.backTranslation: The kitchen also displays Offerings that list the available food. Voucher and Offering are related but distinct: the Voucher promises to be redeemable, while the Offering helps people see the related product or service.

units.source: ### 2. A participant publishes a Want
units.translation: ### 2. Naglalathala ng Pangangailangan ang kalahok
units.backTranslation: ### 2. Participant sets out a Need.

units.source: A nearby school has transport vouchers and needs meals for an event. It publishes a Want describing the meals, quantity, place, timing, and contact method.
units.translation: May Voucher sa transportasyon ang kalapit na paaralan at kailangan nito ng pagkain para sa isang pagtitipon. Naglalathala ito ng Pangangailangan (Want) na naglalarawan sa pagkain, dami, lugar, oras, at paraan ng pakikipag-ugnayan.
units.backTranslation: A nearby school has a transportation voucher and needs food for a gathering. It publishes a Want that describes the food, quantity, location, time, and way of communication.

units.source: The Want expresses demand. It does not automatically accept the kitchen's voucher, reserve meals, create a contract, authorize a swap, or promise that the school will proceed. The school still needs to review the kitchen, voucher terms, available route, quote, and applicable conditions.
units.translation: Nagpapahayag ng hinahanap ang Pangangailangan. Hindi nito awtomatikong tinatanggap ang Voucher ng kusina, inirereserba ang pagkain, nililikha ang kontrata, pinapahintulutan ang palitan, o ipinapangakong magpapatuloy ang paaralan. Kailangan pa ring suriin ng paaralan ang kusina, mga tuntunin ng Voucher, mga available na ruta, quote, at naaangkop na kondisyon.
units.backTranslation: It does not automatically accept the kitchen voucher, reserve food, create a contract, allow exchanges, or promise continuation by the school. The school still needs to review the kitchen, terms of the vouchers, available routes, quotes, and applicable conditions.

units.source: ### 3. Independent Pool Stewards curate a route
units.translation: ### 3. Pinipili ng magkahiwalay na Tagapangasiwa ng Pool ang ruta
units.backTranslation: ### 3. The separate Pool Administrator selects the route.

units.source: Two independently governed Pools connect the assets:
units.translation: Dalawang Pool na magkakahiwalay ang pamamahala ang nag-uugnay sa mga asset:
units.backTranslation: Two separately managed Pools link the assets: the Pool of the Sea and the Pool for the Sea.

units.source: 1. a mobility Pool admits the school's transport voucher and a maize voucher; and
units.translation: 1. tumatanggap ang isang Pool sa transportasyon ng Voucher ng paaralan sa transportasyon at isang Voucher sa mais; at
units.backTranslation: 1. receives a Transportation Pool of School Transportation Vouchers and a Corn Voucher; and

units.source: 2. a food-security Pool admits that maize voucher and the kitchen's meal voucher.
units.translation: 2. tumatanggap ang isang Pool para sa seguridad sa pagkain ng parehong Voucher sa mais at ng Voucher ng kusina sa pagkain.
units.backTranslation: 2. a Pool for food security receives both the corn voucher and the kitchen food voucher.

units.source: Each Pool Steward reviews the assets and publishes that Pool's own rules, including:
units.translation: Sinusuri ng bawat Tagapangasiwa ng Pool ang mga asset at inilalathala ang sariling mga patakaran ng Pool, kabilang ang:
units.backTranslation: Each Pool Administrator reviews assets and publishes its own Pool policies, including: Asset Management Policy

units.source: - the current SwapPool owner, proxy administrator, and material dependency controllers;
units.translation: - ang kasalukuyang may-ari ng SwapPool, proxy administrator, at mahahalagang dependency controller;
units.backTranslation: - the current owner of SwapPool, proxy administrator, and critical dependency controller; and

units.source: - admitted vouchers and other supported assets;
units.translation: - mga tinanggap na Voucher at ibang suportadong asset;
units.backTranslation: - Vouchers and other supported assets accepted; - the amount of Voucher and other backed assets received;

units.source: - exchange-rate or quote methods;
units.translation: - mga paraan ng rate ng palitan o quote;
units.backTranslation: - exchange rate or quote methods;

units.source: - token-balance caps, called “Credit limits” in the App;
units.translation: - mga cap sa balanse ng token na tinatawag na “Credit limit” sa App;
units.backTranslation: - caps on token balance called “Credit limit” in the App;

units.source: - Pool and protocol fees;
units.translation: - mga bayarin sa Pool at protocol;
units.backTranslation: - Pool and protocol fees; - pool fee

units.source: - inventory and liquidity-withdrawal powers; and
units.translation: - imbentaryo at mga kapangyarihan sa pag-withdraw ng liquidity; at
units.backTranslation: - inventory and liquidity withdrawal powers; and - the ability to withdraw liquidity.

units.source: - any separately funded guarantee, reserve, or support arrangement.
units.translation: - anumang garantiya, reserba, o suportang hiwalay na pinondohan.
units.backTranslation: - any warranty, reserve, or support separately funded.

units.source: Admission means that a Pool's configured rules allow a voucher. It does not prove fulfillment capacity, establish cash value, create insurance, or make the two Pools one governed entity.
units.translation: Ang pagtanggap sa Pool ay nangangahulugang pinapayagan ng naka-configure na mga patakaran nito ang Voucher. Hindi nito pinatutunayan ang kakayahan ng Tagapag-isyu, itinatakda ang halagang cash, nililikha ang insurance, o pinagsasama ang dalawang Pool sa iisang pinamamahalaang entidad.
units.backTranslation: Acceptance by the Pool means that its configured policies allow the Voucher. It does not verify the Issuer’s capacity, set the cash value, create insurance, or combine two Pools into one managed entity.

units.source: ### 4. Participants provide inventory
units.translation: ### 4. Nagbibigay ng imbentaryo ang mga kalahok
units.backTranslation: ### 4. Participants provide inventory.

units.source: The mobility Pool holds maize vouchers that can be exchanged for transport vouchers. The food-security Pool holds meal vouchers that can be exchanged for maize vouchers. Participants may have supplied that inventory under different published arrangements.
units.translation: Hawak ng Pool sa transportasyon ang mga Voucher sa mais na maaaring ipalit sa Voucher sa transportasyon. Hawak ng Pool para sa seguridad sa pagkain ang mga Voucher sa pagkain na maaaring ipalit sa Voucher sa mais. Maaaring magbigay ang iba't ibang kalahok ng imbentaryo sa ilalim ng magkakaibang inilathalang kaayusan.
units.backTranslation: The Transport Pool holds corn Vouchers that can be exchanged for transport vouchers. The Food Security Pool holding food voucher that can Be exchanged to maize voucher. Various participants may provide inventory under different listing arrangements.

units.source: A deposit increases available Pool inventory, but it does not automatically create a Pool share, repayment claim, withdrawal right, reward, or governance power. Any such right must come from a separate disclosed arrangement.
units.translation: Nadaragdagan ng deposito ang magagamit na imbentaryo ng Pool, ngunit hindi ito awtomatikong lumilikha ng bahagi sa Pool o karapatan sa pagbabayad, withdrawal, reward, o pamamahala. Kailangang manggaling ang gayong mga karapatan sa hiwalay na isiniwalat na kaayusan.
units.backTranslation: The deposit increases the Pool’s available inventory, but does not automatically create a share in the Pool or rights to payment, withdrawal, reward, or management. Such rights must arise from separately disclosed arrangements.

units.source: ### 5. The App discovers and quotes a route
units.translation: ### 5. Nakakahanap ang App ng ruta at nagbibigay ng quote
units.backTranslation: ### 5. The App finds the route and provides a quote.

units.source: The school's wallet opens the Credit view and selects the meal voucher. CLC Core estimates a possible path:
units.translation: Binubuksan ng Wallet ng paaralan ang view na Kredito at pinipili ang Voucher sa pagkain. Tinatantiya ng CLC Core ang posibleng daan:
units.backTranslation: The school Wallet opens the Credit view and selects Food Voucher. CLC Core predicts the possible path: Credit to the school wallet.

units.source: This discovery result is not yet a promise that the exchange will succeed. Every hop depends on current admission, Pool token-balance caps, available inventory, quote and fee configuration, supported token behavior, and service freshness.
units.translation: Hindi pa pangakong magtatagumpay ang palitan ang resultang ito. Nakasalalay ang bawat hop sa kasalukuyang pagtanggap, mga cap ng Pool sa balanse ng token, magagamit na imbentaryo, configuration ng quote at bayarin, suportadong kilos ng token, at pagiging napapanahon ng datos ng serbisyo.
units.backTranslation: This result is not a promise that the exchange will succeed. Each hop depends on current acceptance, Pool caps on token balances, available inventory, quote and charge configuration, supported token actions, and timeliness of service data.

units.source: The school chooses how much it wants to Get or Spend. The App presents a quote for the complete exchange. Route details show both swaps, the amounts, and each step's Pool and protocol fees. The school reviews the minimum received and quote expiry before proceeding.
units.translation: Pinipili ng paaralan ang halagang nais nitong Kunin o Gastusin. Nagku-quote ang App para sa buong palitan. Ipinapakita ng Mga detalye ng ruta ang dalawang hop, mga halaga, at bayarin sa Pool at protocol sa bawat hakbang. Sinusuri ng paaralan ang minimum na matatanggap at pag-expire ng quote bago magpatuloy.
units.backTranslation: The App quotes for the entire exchange. Route Details shows the two hops, values, and Pool and protocol fees at each step. The school checks the minimum receipt and quote expiration before proceeding.

units.source: ### 6. The Holder executes the routed exchange
units.translation: ### 6. Isinasagawa ng Mayhawak ang routed exchange
units.backTranslation: ### 6. The Routed Exchange is performed by the Holder.

units.source: The school selects Confirm exchange and authorizes the complete route. If it succeeds, the receipt shows the two Pool swaps, the exchanged amounts, and the fees.
units.translation: Pinipili ng paaralan ang Kumpirmahin ang palitan at pinapahintulutan ang buong ruta. Kapag nagtagumpay, ipinapakita ng resibo ang dalawang palitan sa Pool, mga halagang ipinagpalit, at mga bayarin.
units.backTranslation: The school selects Confirm Exchange and authorizes the full route. When successful, a receipt shows the two exchanges in the Pool, amounts exchanged, and fees.

units.source: If a step fails, both Pool swaps revert together; the first does not remain settled without the second. For how the software constructs and executes that transaction, see the routing reference (English).
units.translation: Kung mabigo ang isang hakbang, sabay-sabay na nababawi ang dalawang palitan sa Pool; hindi mananatiling settled ang una nang wala ang ikalawa. Para sa pagbuo at pagsasagawa ng transaksyon sa software, tingnan ang sanggunian sa routing (Ingles).
units.backTranslation: If one step fails, the two exchanges are simultaneously settled in the Pool; the first will not remain settled without the second. For building and executing a transaction in software, see the routing reference.

units.source: The school now holds meal vouchers. The on-chain exchange is swap settlement. It gives the school the resulting claim described by the meal-voucher terms; it does not prove that the kitchen has already supplied food.
units.translation: Hawak na ngayon ng paaralan ang mga Voucher sa pagkain. Ang palitan sa blockchain ay swap settlement. Ibinibigay nito sa paaralan ang karapatang nakasaad sa mga tuntunin ng Voucher sa pagkain; hindi nito pinatutunayang nakapagbigay na ng pagkain ang kusina.
units.backTranslation: The exchange on the blockchain is a swap settlement. It gives the school the right set out in the terms of the food voucher; it does not prove that the kitchen has already provided the meals.

units.source: ### 7. The Holder presents the Voucher
units.translation: ### 7. Inihaharap ng Mayhawak ang Voucher
units.backTranslation: ### 7. The Holder presents the Voucher to the Vehicle Operator.

units.source: In the current App, choosing “Redeem” opens the ordinary send flow with the token owner's address prefilled. Sending the voucher back is evidence of presentment to the issuer; it does not by itself prove that the kitchen supplied a meal.
units.translation: Sa kasalukuyang App, binubuksan ng “Tubusin” ang karaniwang pagpapadala na nakalagay na ang address ng may-ari ng token. Ebidensiya ng paghaharap sa Tagapag-isyu ang pagpapadala pabalik ng Voucher; hindi ito, sa sarili nito, patunay na nagbigay na ng pagkain ang kusina.
units.backTranslation: In the current App, “Redeem” opens a regular delivery with the address of the token owner already listed. The return shipment of the Voucher is evidence of presentation to the Issuer; it is not, in itself, proof that food has been provided by the kitchen.

units.source: The school follows the kitchen's booking or contact process. The kitchen verifies the presentment and provides the promised meals under its published terms.
units.translation: Sinusunod ng paaralan ang proseso ng kusina para sa booking o pakikipag-ugnayan. Tinitiyak ng kusina ang paghaharap at ibinibigay ang ipinangakong pagkain ayon sa inilathalang mga tuntunin.
units.backTranslation: The school follows the kitchen process for booking or communication. The kitchen ensures presentation and delivers the promised food according to written terms.

units.source: ### 8. The Issuer records fulfillment and discharge
units.translation: ### 8. Itinatala ng Tagapag-isyu ang pagtupad at discharge
units.backTranslation: ### 8. The Issuer records the performance and discharge of the obligation.

units.source: After providing the meals, the kitchen records the fulfilled units so they cannot be presented twice. Depending on the published process, this may involve receiving, burning, cancelling, or otherwise disabling the returned voucher.
units.translation: Pagkatapos magbigay ng pagkain, itinatala ng kusina ang mga natupad nang yunit upang hindi maiharap nang dalawang beses. Depende sa inilathalang proseso, maaaring kabilang dito ang pagtanggap, pag-burn, pagkansela, o ibang paraan ng pagpapahinto sa paggamit ng ibinalik na Voucher.
units.backTranslation: After serving food, the kitchen records the completed units so that they are not submitted twice. Depending on the process recorded, this may include acceptance, burning, cancellation, or otherwise stopping the use of the returned Voucher.

units.source: If the kitchen does not honor its commitment, the holder uses the issuer's published complaint or remedy process and any rights available under applicable law. Neither GEF nor either Pool Steward becomes the redeemer merely because the App found the route or the Pools enabled its swaps.
units.translation: Kung hindi tumupad ang kusina, ginagamit ng Mayhawak ang inilathalang proseso ng reklamo o remedyo ng Tagapag-isyu at anumang karapatan sa ilalim ng naaangkop na batas. Hindi nagiging tagatubos ang GEF o alinmang Tagapangasiwa dahil lamang nahanap ng App ang ruta o nagbigay-daan ang mga Pool sa palitan.
units.backTranslation: If the kitchen fails to comply, the Holder will use the Issuer's published complaint or remedy process and any rights under applicable law. The GEF or any Administrator will not become a redeemer simply because the App has found the route or allowed Pools to exchange.

units.source: Choosing “Request retirement” is different: the current owner asks an administrator to retire the Voucher. The Voucher remains active while the request is pending, and the request can be approved, rejected, or cancelled. Approved retirement removes it from active catalog use but does not delete its contract, balances, history, or outstanding obligations. It is not fulfillment, discharge, burning, or cancellation.
units.translation: Iba ang “Humiling ng pag-retire”: hinihiling ng kasalukuyang may-ari sa administrator na i-retire ang Voucher. Aktibo pa rin ang Voucher habang nakabinbin ang hiling, na maaaring aprubahan, tanggihan, o kanselahin. Inaalis ito ng aprubadong pag-retire sa aktibong paggamit sa katalogo ngunit hindi binubura ang contract, mga balanse, kasaysayan, o hindi pa natutupad na obligasyon. Hindi ito pagtupad, discharge, pag-burn, o pagkansela.
units.backTranslation: The Voucher remains active while the request is pending, which can be approved, denied, or cancelled. This removes the approved retirement from active use in the catalog but does not erase contracts, balances, history, or outstanding obligations. It is not fulfilling, discharge, burning, or canceling.

units.source: - Issuer: describes and fulfills the voucher and records discharge.
units.translation: - Tagapag-isyu: inilalarawan at tinutupad ang Voucher at itinatala ang discharge.
units.backTranslation: - Issuer: describes and fulfills the Voucher and records discharge.

units.source: - Person publishing a Want: describes a need without automatically accepting a voucher or route.
units.translation: - Naglalathala ng Pangangailangan: inilalarawan ang kailangan nang hindi awtomatikong tumatanggap ng Voucher o ruta.
units.backTranslation: - Describes Need: describes the need without automatically receiving a Voucher or route.

units.source: - Pool Stewards: independently publish and administer each Pool's rules, rates, fees, limits, controls, and any expressly assumed guarantee.
units.translation: - Mga Tagapangasiwa ng Pool: magkakahiwalay na naglalathala at nangangasiwa sa mga patakaran, rate, bayarin, limitasyon, kontrol, at anumang hayagang inaakong garantiya ng bawat Pool.
units.backTranslation: - Pool Administrators: separately publish and administer each Pool’s policies, rates, fees, limits, controls, and any implied guarantees.

units.source: - Holder: reviews the issuer, voucher terms, Pools, route quote, fees, wallet authorization, and applicable law.
units.translation: - Mayhawak: sinusuri ang Tagapag-isyu, mga tuntunin ng Voucher, mga Pool, quote ng ruta, bayarin, awtorisasyon ng Wallet, at naaangkop na batas.
units.backTranslation: - Holder: reviewing the Issuer, Voucher terms, Pools, route quotes, fees, Wallet authorizations, and applicable law.

units.source: - CLC App and CLC Core: discover and quote possible routes, prepare and relay the signed batch, and group technical settlement records. They do not prove issuer fulfillment.
units.translation: - CLC App at CLC Core: naghahanap at nagku-quote ng posibleng ruta, naghahanda at nagre-relay ng pinirmahang batch, at pinagsasama ang mga teknikal na tala ng settlement. Hindi nila pinatutunayan ang pagtupad ng Tagapag-isyu.
units.backTranslation: - CLC App and CLC Core: finds and quotes possible routes, prepares and relays signed batches, and consolidates technical settlement records. They do not verify the Issuer’s compliance.

units.source: - Technical controllers: exercise only the contract, dependency, upgrade, catalog, routing-service, or fee powers assigned to them.
units.translation: - Mga teknikal na controller: ginagamit lamang ang itinalagang kapangyarihan sa contract, dependency, upgrade, katalogo, routing service, o bayarin.
units.backTranslation: - Technical controllers: only the assigned power is used on contract, dependency, upgrade, catalog, routing service, or charge.

units.source: - GEF: operates the CLC App and supporting infrastructure, subject to the Terms of Service; it does not automatically take on the other roles.
units.translation: - GEF: nagpapatakbo ng CLC App at sumusuportang imprastraktura, alinsunod sa Mga Tuntunin ng Serbisyo; hindi nito awtomatikong inaako ang ibang tungkulin.
units.backTranslation: - GEF: operates the CLC App and supporting infrastructure, in accordance with the Terms of Service; this does not automatically assume any other role.

units.source: ## When a route is unavailable
units.translation: ## Kapag walang available na ruta
units.backTranslation: ## When there is no available route

units.source: The App may find no route, or a quote may fail, when inventory is insufficient, a Pool cap would be exceeded, a voucher is not admitted, a token or quoter is unsupported, the wallet lacks enough input, the route data is stale, or the final batch simulation fails. A quote can also expire or become invalid before submission as Pool state changes.
units.translation: Maaaring walang mahanap na ruta ang App o mabigo ang quote kapag kulang ang imbentaryo, lalampas sa cap ng Pool, hindi tinatanggap ang Voucher, hindi suportado ang token o quoter, kulang ang input sa Wallet, luma ang datos ng ruta, o nabigo ang huling simulation ng batch. Maaari ring mag-expire o mawalan ng bisa ang quote bago isumite dahil nagbabago ang kalagayan ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: The App may not find a route or the quote may fail when inventory is low, Pool cap exceeded, Voucher not accepted, token or quoter not supported, Wallet input is insufficient, route data is outdated, or last batch simulation failed. The quote may also expire or become invalid before submission due to changes in Pool status.

units.source: That outcome does not change the Want, the Offering, or the Issuer's existing Voucher obligations. The participant can refresh the route, choose a smaller amount, use another eligible input Voucher, or wait for Pool conditions to change.
units.translation: Hindi binabago ng resultang iyon ang Pangangailangan, Offering, o mga umiiral na obligasyon ng Tagapag-isyu sa Voucher. Maaaring i-refresh ng kalahok ang ruta, pumili ng mas maliit na halaga, gumamit ng ibang kwalipikadong input Voucher, o maghintay na magbago ang kalagayan ng Pool.
units.backTranslation: That result does not change the Requirement, Offering, or existing obligations of the Voucher Issuer. The participant may refresh the route, choose a smaller amount, use another qualifying input Voucher, or wait for the Pool status to change.

units.source: ## Future credit arrangements
units.translation: ## Mga kaayusan sa kredito sa hinaharap
units.backTranslation: ## Future credit arrangements

units.source: A future Pool or other responsible party could separately offer a transaction as a repayable advance, secured transaction, or other credit product. Such a product would require separately presented supplemental and transaction terms identifying the parties, amounts, due dates, fees or interest, collateral treatment, assignment, default, remedies, and discharge evidence.
units.translation: Maaaring hiwalay na mag-alok ang isang Pool o ibang responsableng partido ng transaksyon bilang paunang pondong kailangang ibalik, secured transaction, o ibang credit product sa hinaharap. Kailangan nito ng hiwalay na inilahad na supplemental at transaction terms na tumutukoy sa mga partido, halaga, takdang petsa, bayarin o interes, pagtrato sa collateral, pagtatalaga ng mga karapatan, default, remedyo, at ebidensiya ng discharge.
units.backTranslation: A Pool or other responsible party may separately offer the transaction as an initial repayable, secured transaction, or other future credit product. This requires separately stated supplemental and transaction terms specifying parties, amount, due dates, fees or interest, treatment of collateral, assignment of rights, default, remedies, and evidence of discharge.

units.source: An ordinary send, Pool deposit, direct or routed Pool swap, voucher presentment, fulfillment, or discharge does not create those obligations on its own.
units.translation: Hindi nililikha ng karaniwang pagpapadala, deposito sa Pool, direkta o routed na palitan sa Pool, paghaharap ng Voucher, pagtupad, o discharge ang mga obligasyong iyon sa sarili nito.
units.backTranslation: Ordinary sending, depositing in the Pool, direct or routed exchanges in the pool, presentation of Vouchers, performance, or discharge do not create those obligations in themselves.

units.source: Governance in Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC) is divided among distinct roles rather than assigned to one universal authority. This page describes governance options for CLC-compatible networks; it does not prescribe a single legal form, voting system, or organization.
units.translation: Nahahati ang pamamahala sa Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC) sa magkakaibang tungkulin sa halip na italaga sa iisang pangkalahatang awtoridad. Inilalarawan dito ang mga opsyon sa pamamahala para sa mga network na katugma sa CLC; hindi ito nagtatakda ng iisang legal na anyo, sistema ng pagboto, o organisasyon.
units.backTranslation: Cosmo-Local Credit (CLC) governance is divided into different roles rather than assigned to a single overall authority. This describes the governance options for CLC compatible networks; it does not prescribe a single legal form, voting system, or organization.

units.source: Grassroots Economics Foundation (GEF) operates the public progressive web app at cosmolocal.credit and its supporting services. In that role, GEF may maintain interfaces and catalogs, apply minimum listing or safety standards, moderate content, restrict App features, and coordinate technical operations. Unless it expressly accepts another role for a particular arrangement, GEF is not the Issuer of a user-created Voucher, the Steward of a user-created Pool, a guarantor, insurer, custodian, lender, borrower, redeemer, or party to a user-to-user transaction.
units.translation: Pinapatakbo ng Grassroots Economics Foundation (GEF) ang pampublikong progressive web app sa cosmolocal.credit at mga sumusuportang serbisyo nito. Sa tungkuling ito, maaaring panatilihin ng GEF ang mga interface at katalogo, magpatupad ng pinakamababang pamantayan sa listing o kaligtasan, mag-moderate ng content, maglimita ng mga feature, at mag-ugnay ng teknikal na operasyon. Maliban kung hayagang tumanggap ang GEF ng ibang tungkulin para sa partikular na kaayusan, hindi ito ang Tagapag-isyu ng Voucher na ginawa ng user, Tagapangasiwa ng Pool na ginawa ng user, guarantor, insurer, custodian, nagpapautang, nangungutang, tagatubos, o partido sa transaksyon ng mga user.
units.backTranslation: The Grassroots Economics Foundation (GEF) operates the public progressive web app on cosmolocal.credit and its supporting services. In this role, GEF may maintain interfaces and catalogues, enforce minimum listing or security standards, moderate content, limit features, and coordinate technical operations. Unless GEF voluntarily assumes other roles for a particular arrangement, it is not the User-Made Voucher Issuer, User-made Pool Administrator, guarantor, insurer, custodian, lender, borrower, redeemer, or party to user transactions.

units.source: The Terms of Service govern use of the public App and explain these responsibilities in detail.
units.translation: Saklaw ng Mga Tuntunin ng Serbisyo ang paggamit ng pampublikong App at detalyadong ipinapaliwanag dito ang mga pananagutan.
units.backTranslation: The Terms of Service cover the use of the public App and explain responsibilities in detail. Responsibilities are explained herein.

units.source: Concepts and vocabulary maps these public roles to contract ownership, proxy administration, dependency control, catalog moderation, and fee receipt.
units.translation: Iniuugnay ng Mga konsepto at bokabularyo ang mga pampublikong tungkulin sa pagmamay-ari ng contract, proxy administration, dependency control, pangangasiwa ng katalogo, at pagtanggap ng bayarin.
units.backTranslation: Concepts and Vocabulary relates public duties to contract ownership, proxy administration, dependency control, catalog management, and receipt of payment.

units.source: - Voucher Issuers govern their own Offerings. They publish accurate identity, capacity, supply, valuation, expiry, presentment, fulfillment, geographic, timing, fee, restriction, and remedy information, and they remain responsible for honoring those commitments.
units.translation: - Mga Tagapag-isyu ng Voucher ang namamahala sa sarili nilang Offering. Naglalathala sila ng tumpak na impormasyon sa pagkakakilanlan, kakayahan, supply, valuation, pag-expire, paghaharap, pagtupad, lugar, oras, bayarin, paghihigpit, at remedyo, at nananatiling responsable sa mga pangako.
units.backTranslation: - Voucher Issuers are the owners of their own Offerings. They publish accurate information on identity, capacity, supply, valuation, expiration, presentation, performance, place, time, charges, restrictions, and remedies, and remain responsible for the promises made.

units.source: - Pool Stewards govern admission, asset curation, valuation, fees, limits, inventory, reserves, contributions, conflicts, provenance, configuration, pauses, upgrades, and any guarantee or loss-allocation mechanism for their Pools.
units.translation: - Mga Tagapangasiwa ng Pool ang namamahala sa pagtanggap, pagpili ng asset, valuation, bayarin, limitasyon, imbentaryo, reserba, kontribusyon, tunggalian, pinagmulan, configuration, paghinto, upgrade, at anumang garantiya o paraan ng paghahati ng pagkalugi sa kanilang Pool.
units.backTranslation: - Pool Administrators manage the receipt, asset selection, valuation, fees, limitations, inventory, reserves, contributions, disputes, origination, configuration, suspension, upgrade, and any guarantee or loss allocation in their Pool.

units.source: - Registry and service stewards may govern which Pools or assets appear in a registry and the operating rules for discovery, routing, monitoring, liquidity support, or other shared services. Their service authority does not automatically extend to a Pool's assets or an issuer's obligations.
units.translation: - Mga tagapangasiwa ng registry at serbisyo ay maaaring magtakda kung aling Pool o asset ang lalabas sa registry at ang mga patakaran sa pagtuklas, routing, pagsubaybay, suporta sa liquidity, o ibang pinagsasaluhang serbisyo. Hindi awtomatikong umaabot ang awtoridad nila sa mga asset ng Pool o obligasyon ng Tagapag-isyu.
units.backTranslation: - Registry and service administrators may determine which Pool or asset appears in the registry and the policies for discovery, routing, tracking, liquidity support, or other associated services. Their authority does not automatically extend to Pool assets or Issuer obligations.

units.source: - Users decide whether an Issuer, Voucher, Pool, quote, and transaction are acceptable and lawful for them. A registry entry or App listing is not a guarantee or endorsement.
units.translation: - Mga user ang nagpapasya kung katanggap-tanggap at legal para sa kanila ang Tagapag-isyu, Voucher, Pool, quote, at transaksyon. Hindi garantiya o pag-endorso ang pagkakalista sa registry o App.
units.backTranslation: - Users decide whether the Issuer, Voucher, Pool, quote, and transaction is acceptable and legal to them. Listing in the registry or App. does not guarantee or endorse it.

units.source: One person or organization can hold more than one role, but it should disclose each role and the conflicts and obligations that follow from it.
units.translation: Maaaring gampanan ng isang tao o organisasyon ang higit sa isang tungkulin, ngunit dapat isiwalat ang bawat tungkulin at ang kaakibat na mga tunggalian at obligasyon.
units.backTranslation: A person or organization may have more than one role, but each role and the conflicts and obligations associated with it must be disclosed.

units.source: A Pool Steward is accountable for that Pool's published curation, valuation, limitations, fees, exchange conditions, accepted commitments, inventory policy, local disputes, repair process, and authorized governance changes. Technical authority may be distributed among a SwapPool owner, proxy administrator, dependency controllers, multisig signers, and fee recipients; the public rules should identify those powers rather than treating them as one role.
units.translation: Pananagutan ng Tagapangasiwa ng Pool ang inilathalang pagpili, valuation, limitasyon, bayarin, kondisyon ng palitan, tinanggap na pangako, patakaran sa imbentaryo, lokal na pagtatalo, proseso ng pag-aayos, at awtorisadong pagbabago sa pamamahala. Maaaring hatiin ang teknikal na awtoridad sa may-ari ng SwapPool, proxy administrator, dependency controller, multisig signer, at tatanggap ng bayarin; dapat tukuyin ng pampublikong mga patakaran ang mga kapangyarihan sa halip na ituring na iisang tungkulin ang mga ito.
units.backTranslation: The Pool Administrator is responsible for the listed selection, valuation, limitation, fees, exchange conditions, accepted pledges, inventory policy, local disputes, settlement process, and authorized management changes. Technical authority may be divided between SwapPool owner, proxy administrator, dependency controller, multisig signer, and fee receiver; public policies should define powers rather than treat them as a single role.

units.source: Repair within a Pool remains with its authorized governance and responsible parties. A Steward may correct a configuration, suspend an admission, address a local dispute, or adopt a remedy within its authority. It cannot erase public transaction history or silently discharge an issuer's separate voucher obligation.
units.translation: Nananatili sa awtorisadong pamamahala at responsableng partido ang pag-aayos sa loob ng Pool. Maaaring iwasto ng Tagapangasiwa ang configuration, ihinto ang pagtanggap ng asset, tugunan ang lokal na pagtatalo, o magpatupad ng remedyo sa loob ng awtoridad nito. Hindi nito mabubura ang pampublikong kasaysayan ng transaksyon o palihim na maaalis ang hiwalay na obligasyon ng Tagapag-isyu sa Voucher.
units.backTranslation: The Administrator may correct the configuration, stop accepting the asset, address local disputes, or enforce remedies within its authority. This will not erase the public transaction history or secretly remove the Issuer’s separate obligation to the Voucher.

units.source: The CLC App and its supporting services help participants discover Vouchers, arrange exchanges, and check outcomes. Operators are responsible for their own services and for explaining service failures. The definitive software documentation describes the supporting systems and their operation in English.
units.translation: Tinutulungan ng CLC App at mga sumusuportang serbisyo ang mga kalahok na makahanap ng Voucher, mag-ayos ng palitan, at tingnan ang resulta. Responsable ang mga operator sa sarili nilang serbisyo at pagpapaliwanag ng mga pagkabigo nito. Inilalarawan sa pangunahing dokumentasyon ng software ang mga sumusuportang sistema at pagpapatakbo ng mga ito, sa Ingles.
units.backTranslation: The CLC App and supporting services help participants find Vouchers, arrange exchanges, and view the results. Operators are responsible for their own service and explaining its failures. The main software documentation describes the supporting systems and how they operate.

units.source: An operator can pause or correct its own service, refresh indexed state, exclude unsupported paths, explain a failure, and coordinate with affected Stewards. That operational role does not grant authority to change an independent Pool's rules, move its inventory, waive an issuer's commitment, or decide a local fulfillment dispute.
units.translation: Maaaring ihinto o ayusin ng operator ang sarili nitong serbisyo, i-refresh ang indexed state, ibukod ang hindi suportadong daan, ipaliwanag ang pagkabigo, at makipag-ugnayan sa apektadong Tagapangasiwa. Hindi nito binibigyan ang operator ng awtoridad na baguhin ang mga patakaran ng hiwalay na Pool, ilipat ang imbentaryo nito, talikuran ang pangako ng Tagapag-isyu, o magpasya sa lokal na pagtatalo sa pagtupad.
units.backTranslation: The operator may suspend or fix its own service, refresh the indexed state, exclude unsupported path, explain the failure, and contact the affected Administrator. This does not give the operator the authority to change the separate Pool’s policies, move its inventory, override the Issuer’s commitment, or decide on local compliance disputes.

units.source: Current participant-initiated routing also does not authorize automatic Pool rebalancing. Any rebalancing, netting, shared-liquidity, guarantee, or insurance service would require separate opt-in authority, controls, responsible parties, and published terms.
units.translation: Hindi rin pinapahintulutan ng kasalukuyang routing na sinisimulan ng kalahok ang awtomatikong pagbabalanse ng Pool. Kailangan ng anumang rebalancing, netting, shared-liquidity, guarantee, o insurance service ng hiwalay na kusang-loob na awtorisasyon, kontrol, responsableng partido, at inilathalang mga tuntunin.
units.backTranslation: Current routing also does not allow participants to initiate automatic Pool balancing. Any rebalancing, netting, shared-liquidity, guarantee, or insurance service requires separate voluntary authorization, control, responsible party, and listed terms.

units.source: A registry or catalog steward may address incorrect listings, identity and metadata integrity, registry permissions, publication status, service failures, and correction, suspension, or appeal procedures. A registry record helps discovery; it is not itself an issuer-capacity assessment, Pool guarantee, or fulfillment record.
units.translation: Maaaring tugunan ng tagapangasiwa ng registry o katalogo ang maling listing, pagkakakilanlan at integridad ng metadata, mga pahintulot sa registry, katayuan ng paglalathala, pagkabigo ng serbisyo, at mga proseso ng pagwawasto, paghinto, o apela. Nakatutulong ang tala sa registry sa pagtuklas; hindi ito, sa sarili nito, pagtatasa ng kakayahan ng Tagapag-isyu, garantiya ng Pool, o tala ng pagtupad.
units.backTranslation: The registry or catalog administrator may address incorrect listing, identity and integrity of metadata, registry permissions, publishing status, service failures, and correction, suspension, or appeal processes. The registrys record is a discovery aid; it is not, in itself, an assessment of the Issuer’s capability, Pool guarantee, or compliance record.

units.source: Correcting or removing a listing does not reverse an on-chain settlement, remove a balance, change a Pool's independently governed configuration, or discharge an outstanding commitment. Those outcomes require the authority and process applicable to the relevant contract, Pool, issuer, or legal obligation.
units.translation: Hindi binabaligtad ng pagwawasto o pag-alis ng listing ang settlement sa blockchain, inaalis ang balanse, binabago ang sariling pinamamahalaang configuration ng Pool, o dini-discharge ang hindi pa natutupad na pangako. Kailangan ng mga resultang iyon ang awtoridad at prosesong naaangkop sa kaugnay na contract, Pool, Tagapag-isyu, o legal na obligasyon.
units.backTranslation: Amendment or de-listing does not reverse the blockchain settlement, remove the balance, change the Pool’s own managed configuration, or discharge an outstanding pledge. Those results require the authority and process appropriate to the relevant contract, Pool, Issuer, or legal obligation.

units.source: A routed exchange preserves the boundaries between its Pools. Each Pool applies its own rules and controls. A combined receipt does not merge Pool governance or transfer an Issuer's responsibility to the route operator. For the technical transaction records, use the software swap reference.
units.translation: Pinananatili ng routed exchange ang mga hangganan ng mga Pool. Inilalapat ng bawat Pool ang sariling mga patakaran at kontrol. Hindi pinagsasama ng iisang resibo ang pamamahala ng mga Pool o inililipat ang pananagutan ng Tagapag-isyu sa operator ng ruta. Para sa mga teknikal na tala ng transaksyon, gamitin ang sanggunian sa palitan ng software.
units.backTranslation: The routed exchange maintains the boundaries of the Pools. Each Pool applies its own policies and controls. A single receipt does not consolidate the management of the pools or transfer Issuer responsibility to the route operator. For technical transaction records, use the software exchange reference.

units.source: The receipt can evidence route selection, authorization, transaction status, per-hop settlement amounts, and fees. Real-world presentment, fulfillment, satisfaction, and discharge require separate evidence and remain with the identified issuer and applicable process.
units.translation: Maaaring magbigay ang resibo ng ebidensiya ng pagpili ng ruta, awtorisasyon, katayuan ng transaksyon, settled na halaga sa bawat hop, at bayarin. Kailangan ng hiwalay na ebidensiya ang aktuwal na paghaharap, pagtupad, kasiyahan, at discharge, at nananatili ang pananagutan sa tinukoy na Tagapag-isyu at naaangkop na proseso.
units.backTranslation: The receipt may provide evidence of route selection, authorization, transaction status, amount settled per hop, and charges. Actual presentation, fulfillment, satisfaction, and discharge require separate evidence, and responsibility remains with the designated Issuer and appropriate processes.

units.source: A CLC-compatible Pool, registry, or service can be governed by a nonprofit foundation, cooperative, community group, federation, company, multisig, public agency, institutional board, on-chain voting system, or another accountable structure. Whatever structure is chosen, participants should be able to determine:
units.translation: Maaaring pamahalaan ang Pool, registry, o serbisyong katugma sa CLC ng nonprofit foundation, kooperatiba, grupo ng komunidad, pederasyon, kumpanya, multisig, pampublikong ahensiya, lupon ng institusyon, sistema ng pagboto sa blockchain, o ibang istrukturang may pananagutan. Anuman ang piliin, dapat matukoy ng mga kalahok:
units.backTranslation: A Pool, registry, or service compatible with CLC may be managed by a nonprofit foundation, cooperative, community group, federation, company, multisig, public agency, institutional board, blockchain voting system, or other accountable structure. Whichever is chosen, participants must determine:

units.source: - how assets, Issuers, and participants are admitted, reviewed, suspended, or removed;
units.translation: - paano tinatanggap, sinusuri, sinuspinde, o inaalis ang mga asset, Tagapag-isyu, at kalahok;
units.backTranslation: - how assets, Issuers, and participants are accepted, reviewed, suspended, or removed;

units.source: - how valuations, fees, limits, reserves, guarantees, and other material settings are established and changed;
units.translation: - paano itinatakda at binabago ang valuation, bayarin, limitasyon, reserba, garantiya, at ibang mahahalagang setting;
units.backTranslation: - how to set and change valuation, fees, limits, reserves, guarantees, and other important settings;

units.source: - which dependencies or contracts can be upgraded, replaced, paused, or permanently sealed;
units.translation: - aling dependency o contract ang maaaring i-upgrade, palitan, ihinto, o permanenteng i-seal;
units.backTranslation: - which dependencies or contracts can be upgraded, replaced, stopped, or permanently sealed;

units.source: - how conflicts of interest are disclosed and handled;
units.translation: - paano isinisiwalat at hinahawakan ang mga tunggalian ng interes;
units.backTranslation: - how conflicts of interest are disclosed and managed; how conflict of interest is identified and addressed;

units.source: - what records, notices, approvals, and review periods apply;
units.translation: - anong mga tala, abiso, pag-apruba, at panahon ng pagsusuri ang naaangkop;
units.backTranslation: - what records, notices, approvals, and review periods are applicable; and

units.source: - what emergency powers exist and how their use is reviewed; and
units.translation: - anong kapangyarihan sa emergency ang mayroon at paano sinusuri ang paggamit nito; at
units.backTranslation: - what emergency powers are available and how their use is monitored; and

units.source: - how participants can complain, exit, migrate, or address unresolved obligations.
units.translation: - paano maaaring magreklamo, umalis, lumipat, o tugunan ng mga kalahok ang hindi pa nalulutas na obligasyon.
units.backTranslation: - how participants can complain, leave, move, or address unresolved obligations.

units.source: Published rules should match the powers available in the relevant contracts and services. Governance should keep material decisions transparent and auditable and should not describe convertibility, liquidity, returns, insurance, reserves, or guarantees more broadly than the responsible party can actually provide.
units.translation: Dapat tumugma ang inilathalang mga patakaran sa mga kapangyarihang available sa kaugnay na mga contract at serbisyo.
