Dapat panatilihin ng pamamahala ang mahahalagang desisyon na malinaw at maaaring i-audit, at huwag ilarawan ang convertibility, liquidity, return, insurance, reserba, o garantiya nang higit sa aktuwal na maibibigay ng responsableng partido.
units.backTranslation: Management should keep important decisions clear and auditable, and not describe convertibility, liquidity, return, insurance, reserve, or guarantee beyond what can actually be provided by the responsible party. The published policies must match the powers available to the relevant contracts and services.

units.source: Where token voting is appropriate, a deployment may use OpenZeppelin Governor contracts and an interface such as Tally. Other deployments may rely on multisig approvals, cooperative resolutions, board decisions, public-agency mandates, or hybrid processes.
units.translation: Kung naaangkop ang token voting, maaaring gumamit ang deployment ng mga contract ng OpenZeppelin Governor at interface gaya ng Tally. Maaaring gumamit ang ibang deployment ng multisig approval, resolusyon ng kooperatiba, pasya ng board, mandato ng pampublikong ahensiya, o pinagsamang proseso.
units.backTranslation: If token voting is appropriate, the deployment may use OpenZeppelin Governor contracts and interfaces such as Tally. Other deployments may use multisig approval, cooperative resolution, board decision, public agency mandate, or joint process.

units.source: These tools are optional. The public App currently provides participant-initiated same-chain routing through CLC Core, but that does not imply token voting, automatic rebalancing, netting, shared insurance, network liquidity programs, or central governance by GEF. Each deployment must identify its actual decision-makers, contracts, service providers, and policies.
units.translation: Opsyonal ang mga kasangkapang ito. Nagbibigay ngayon ang pampublikong App ng same-chain routing na sinisimulan ng kalahok sa pamamagitan ng CLC Core, ngunit hindi nito ipinahihiwatig ang token voting, awtomatikong pagbabalanse, netting, shared insurance, network liquidity program, o sentral na pamamahala ng GEF. Dapat tukuyin ng bawat deployment ang aktuwal na gumagawa ng desisyon, contract, service provider, at mga patakaran nito.
units.backTranslation: These tools are optional. The public App now provides same-chain routing initiated by participants through CLC Core, but does not imply token voting, automatic balancing, netting, shared insurance, network liquidity program, or central management of the GEF. Each deployment should identify the actual decision maker, contract, service provider, and its policies.

units.source: An App operator or registry steward may hide, flag, suspend, or remove an item from an interface. That action does not necessarily pause a smart contract, reverse a completed transaction, remove a public-blockchain record, eliminate a balance, or discharge an obligation between users. Governance plans should distinguish interface controls from the authorities that exist on-chain and from legal duties that continue off-chain.
units.translation: Maaaring magtago, mag-flag, magsuspinde, o mag-alis ng item sa interface ang operator ng App o tagapangasiwa ng registry. Hindi nangangahulugan ang kilos na iyon na nahinto ang smart contract, nabaligtad ang tapos nang transaksyon, nabura ang tala sa pampublikong blockchain, nawala ang balanse, o na-discharge ang obligasyon sa pagitan ng mga user. Dapat pag-ibahin ng plano sa pamamahala ang mga kontrol sa interface, awtoridad sa blockchain, at mga legal na tungkuling nagpapatuloy sa labas nito.
units.backTranslation: The App operator or registry administrator may hide, flag, suspend, or remove items on the interface. That action does not mean that the smart contract is terminated, completed transactions are reversed, records in the public blockchain are erased, balances are lost, or obligations between users are discharged. The management plan should alter controls on the Interface, authority on the blockchain, and legal duties continuing outside of it.

units.source: For the broader design, see the White Paper's Governance Mechanics chapter.
units.translation: Para sa mas malawak na disenyo, tingnan ang kabanata sa Mga mekanismo ng pamamahala sa White Paper.
units.backTranslation: For a broader design, see the Governance Mechanisms chapter in the White Paper.

units.source: Current software reference
units.translation: Kasalukuyang sanggunian sa software
units.backTranslation: Current software references.

units.source: This is the published White Paper v0.9. For current software implementation, contracts, APIs, and deployment instructions, use the CLC software documentation.
units.translation: Ito ang inilathalang White Paper v0.9. Para sa kasalukuyang implementasyon ng software, mga contract, API, at gabay sa deployment, gamitin ang dokumentasyon ng CLC software.
units.backTranslation: This is the published White Paper v0.9. For current software implementation, contracts, APIs and deployment guidelines, use the CLC software documentation.

units.source: Read the software documentation (English)
units.translation: Basahin ang dokumentasyon ng software (Ingles)
units.backTranslation: Read the software documentation (English)
